Authors: Aly Magassouba

TOAST: Stochastic Robot Action Tokenization for Autoregressive Vision-Language-Action Models VLA

Stochastic tokenization Action tokenization Autoregressive VLA Robot manipulation Data-efficient learning

简要说明：TOAST 提出了一种随机动作标记化方法，在策略训练期间对同一量化动作序列的替代标记化进行采样，从而改进自回归 VLA 策略学习，尤其是在数据有限的情况下，在 LIBERO 和真实机器人操作任务上得到了验证。

TLDR: TOAST proposes a stochastic action tokenization method that samples alternative tokenizations of the same quantized action sequence during policy training, improving autoregressive VLA policy learning, especially with limited data, as demonstrated on LIBERO and real-robot manipulation tasks.

Abstract: Autoregressive Vision-Language-Action models often represent continuous robot actions as discrete token sequences, enabling action prediction with standard next-token objectives. FAST has substantially improved this representation by compactly encoding action containing diverse temporal frequencies into relatively few tokens. However, while such compression reduces the number of action tokens required for autoregressive prediction, it does not necessarily improve the efficiency of policy learning from limited demonstrations. In particular, FAST typically assigns a single deterministic tokenization to each quantized action sequence, although multiple token sequences can represent and decode to the same robot motion. We investigate whether exploiting this representational redundancy can improve policy learning. In this paper, we propose TOkenization of Action sequences with STochastic sampling (TOAST), a stochastic action tokenization method that samples alternative tokenizations of the same quantized action sequence during policy training. This diversifies the discrete supervision while preserving the underlying robot action and requires no additional demonstrations. Experiments on LIBERO show that TOAST consistently improves over its deterministic counterpart, with the improvement increasing as training data decreases, achieving a 6.8 point gain in success rate when only 1/16 of training data is available. Across four real-robot manipulation tasks, TOAST further improves mean success rate by 15.8 points over the deterministic counterpart. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of stochastic action tokenization for autoregressive robot policy learning, particularly when training data are limited.

摘要（中文）：自回归视觉-语言-动作模型通常将连续的机器人动作表示为离散的token序列，从而能够通过标准的下一token预测目标实现动作预测。FAST通过将包含不同时间频率的紧凑动作编码为相对较少的token，显著改进了这一表示方式。然而，尽管这种压缩减少了自回归预测所需的动作token数量，却未必能提升从有限示范中学习策略的效率。具体而言，FAST通常为每个量化动作序列分配单一的确定性token化结果，尽管多个token序列可以表示并解码为相同的机器人运动。我们探究利用这种表示冗余是否能够改进策略学习。在本文中，我们提出了动作序列的随机token化方法（TOAST），这是一种在策略训练过程中对相同量化动作序列进行替代token化采样的随机动作token化方法。该方法在保持底层机器人动作不变的同时，使离散监督信号多样化，且无需额外的示范数据。在LIBERO上的实验表明，TOAST始终优于其确定性对应方法，且随着训练数据的减少，性能提升更加显著——当仅使用1/16的训练数据时，成功率提升了6.8个百分点。在四项真实机器人操作任务中，TOAST相比确定性对应方法进一步将平均成功率提升了15.8个百分点。这些结果证明了随机动作token化在自回归机器人策略学习中的有效性，尤其是在训练数据有限的情况下。

Kinematic MeanFlow: One-Step Action Generation Policy for Robotic Foundation Models VLA

one-step action generation robotic foundation models flow matching inference latency GR00T-N1.6

简要说明：本文提出了运动学平均流（K-MF），一种用于机器人基础模型的一步动作生成策略，通过将平均流速度场解耦为两个子区间项来避免性能退化，并在GR00T-N1.6上实现了显著的推理加速。

TLDR: This paper proposes Kinematic MeanFlow, a one-step action generation policy for robotic foundation models, which decouples the MeanFlow velocity field into two sub-interval terms to avoid performance collapse and achieves significant inference speedup on GR00T-N1.6.

Abstract: In this paper, we study how to achieve one-step action generation in Robotic Foundation Models (RFMs), aiming to overcome the high inference latency of multi-step flow matching. MeanFlow provides a promising framework for this goal, yet its direct application leads to performance collapse. We discover that this stems from two distinctive dynamics exhibited in the RFM velocity field: (1) the ``local acceleration" exhibits stability early on, but surges sharply towards the end of the denoising process, and (2) the spread of its magnitudes across samples widens as denoising progresses. To address these issues, we introduce Kinematic MeanFlow (K-MF), a novel one-step action policy tailored for RFMs. Specifically, grounded in a kinematic identity, K-MF decouples the time derivative term in the MeanFlow formulation into two sub-interval terms separated by an intermediate point. This decoupled formulation enables the two terms to capture early-stage and late-stage denoising dynamics, respectively, while mitigating the error amplification across the process. As a result, our K-MF empowers RFMs to achieve one-step action generation in both training from scratch and fine-tuning paradigms across diverse tasks, while outperforming multi-step flow matching in most settings. In terms of inference efficiency, K-MF reduces action-head latency of GR00T-N1.6 by 67.5%~74.4% across L40 and Jetson Orin in eager and compiled modes, yielding end-to-end latency reductions of 30.3%~54.9%. Code will be available at https://github.com/IntelChina-AI/K-MF.

Authors: Jiawei Fan, Sifeng Wang, Yuqing Hou, Anbang Yao

Are Frontier VLM Agents Ready to Be Robot Generalists? An Empirical Study with the Embodied Agent Arena VLA

Embodied Agent Arena vision-language models robot generalists task planning manipulation

简要说明：本文介绍了具身智能体竞技场，一个包含1000个案例的基准，涵盖几何、空间推理、可行使性、任务规划和操作，用于评估前沿VLM智能体成为机器人通才的能力，发现精确估计和可用接触定位是强项，而协调的目标导向行动仍是关键差距。

TLDR: This paper introduces the Embodied Agent Arena, a benchmark with 1,000 cases across Geometry, Spatial Reasoning, Affordance, Task Planning, and Manipulation, to evaluate frontier VLM agents as robot generalists, finding that precise estimation and usable-contact localization are strengths while coordinated goal-directed actions remain a key gap.

Abstract: Frontier vision-language models (VLMs) combine scene estimation, interaction grounding, and executable actions. Understanding how these abilities support complete robotic tasks is central to evaluating their readiness as robot generalists. We introduce Embodied Agent Arena to examine where local competence supports, or falls short of, complete task success across Geometry, Spatial Reasoning, Affordance, Task Planning, and Manipulation. The arena contains 1,000 cases drawn from 32 established sources and GeoProbe, our new benchmark for geometric estimation on Blender renders and real-scene images. A minimal harness preserves source observations and operations while separating metric precision, functional grounding, and native goal completion. We evaluate seven VLMs, analyze Astra's task-specific advantages, and compare richer-observation execution protocols and multi-round review. Across the arena, Astra's advantage is strongest in precise estimation and usable-contact localization; completing coordinated, goal-directed actions remains the key gap to robot generalism.

摘要（中文）：前沿视觉-语言模型（VLMs）融合了场景估计、交互 grounding 以及可执行动作。理解这些能力如何支撑完整的机器人任务，是评估其作为机器人通才模型成熟度的核心。我们引入了“具身智能体竞技场”（Embodied Agent Arena），以考察局部能力在几何、空间推理、可供性、任务规划与操作等方面，对完整任务成功起到支撑还是不足的作用。该竞技场包含1,000个案例，来源于32个既有数据集以及我们新提出的基准GeoProbe，后者用于在Blender渲染和真实场景图像上进行几何估计。一个最小化测试框架保留了原始观测与操作，同时区分了度量精度、功能性grounding和原生目标完成度。我们评估了七个视觉-语言模型，分析了Astra在特定任务上的优势，并比较了更丰富观测的执行协议与多轮回顾机制。在整个竞技场中，Astra的优势最显著地体现在精确估计和可用接触点定位上；而完成协调的、目标导向的动作，仍是迈向机器人通才模型的关键差距所在。

Authors: Haojian Huang, Pukun Zhao, Zexi Li, Yehang Zhang, Yangkai Wei, Wenqian Li, Han Yang, Kaiwen Zhou, Ying-Cong Chen, Yinchuan Li

Reactive Humanoid Multi-Contact Using Learned Stability Models HumanoidEmbodied

humanoid multi-contact stability center of pressure reactive planning

简要说明：本文提出了一种人形机器人反应式规划与控制框架，通过手掌接触来抵抗推力稳定身体，利用学习的CoP模型快速评估接触点，并在站立和行走硬件实验中验证。

TLDR: This paper presents a reactive planning and control framework for humanoid robots that uses hand contacts to stabilize against pushes, leveraging a learned CoP model for fast contact evaluation and validated on hardware during standing and walking.

Abstract: We present a planning and control approach to reactively use hand contacts to stabilize a humanoid in low stability scenarios, where only using feet contacts may result in a fall. Candidate contacts are sampled within the robot's reachable workspace, and a preview is computed by rolling out the centroidal dynamics through pre-impact, impact and post-impact phases. Sampled points are scored based on the Center of Pressure (CoP) control authority at the post-impact phase. Central to our approach is a learned model of the robot's CoP region during post-impact, which enables rapid evaluation of candidate contact points compared to traditional optimization-based methods. The presented planner has two stages: the first selects an optimal bracing region and the second computes an optimal bracing point within the region. Our simulation results demonstrate an average increase in impulse resilience of 89% over recovery without hand contacts and 17% over a naive planning strategy (closest reachable region). We validate our framework on hardware, performing push tests while standing and walking. The standing trials show an average 43% reduction in stabilization time compared to naive hand placement and the walking trials demonstrate a 18% reduction compared to baseline recovery (without hand contacts).

摘要（中文）：我们提出了一种规划与控制方法，用于在低稳定性场景中反应性地利用手部接触来稳定人形机器人，此时仅依靠脚部接触可能导致摔倒。在机器人可达工作空间内对候选接触点进行采样，并通过滚动质心动力学在碰撞前、碰撞瞬间和碰撞后阶段进行预演。根据碰撞后阶段压力中心（CoP）的控制能力对采样点进行评分。我们方法的核心是一个学习得到的机器人碰撞后CoP区域模型，与传统基于优化的方法相比，该模型能够快速评估候选接触点。所提出的规划器包含两个阶段：第一阶段选择最优支撑区域，第二阶段在该区域内计算最优支撑点。仿真结果表明，与不使用手部接触的恢复相比，冲量鲁棒性平均提高了89%；与朴素规划策略（最近可达区域）相比，平均提高了17%。我们在硬件上验证了该框架，在站立和行走状态下进行推力测试。站立试验显示，与朴素手部放置相比，稳定时间平均缩短了43%；行走试验显示，与基线恢复（不使用手部接触）相比，稳定时间平均缩短了18%。

Authors: Stephen McCrory, Beomyeong Park, Nicholas Kitchel, Nehar Poddar, Robert Griffin

Getting Out and Getting Back: World and Behavior Grounding in Real2Sim2Real Co-Training Manipulation

real2sim2real world grounding behavior grounding co-training dexterous manipulation

简要说明：本文研究了在 real2sim2real 协同训练流程中，世界接地和行为接地如何影响灵巧抓取分类任务的策略性能，发现两者都能提高成功率，其中世界接地的收益更大，并表明即使在协同训练基础模型时，接地模拟仍然有用。

TLDR: This paper investigates how world grounding and behavior grounding in a real2sim2real co-training pipeline affect policy performance on a dexterous pick-and-sort task, finding that both improve success rates, with world grounding providing the larger benefit, and showing that grounded simulation remains useful even when co-training foundation models.

Abstract: Simulation can expand scarce real demonstrations for co-training, yet how world fidelity and similarity to human behavior affect policy performance remains unclear. We distinguish world grounding, which aligns simulation with the real system, and behavior grounding, which aligns simulated trajectories with human motion. We build a real2sim2real pipeline that varies these axes independently to generate data for co-training. On a dynamic dexterous pick-and-sort task, fully grounded co-training raises success from 52% to 86%; averaged across configurations, world grounding improves success by 18 percentage points and behavior grounding by 10. Deployed policies behave like a mixture of real-derived and simulation-derived policies, imitating real demonstrations in covered states and relying on simulated behavior elsewhere, which we examine through latent-space analysis. Together, these results suggest complementary roles: world grounding lets policies use simulated experience beyond real-data coverage, while behavior grounding matters mainly when world grounding is imperfect. Grounded simulation remains beneficial when co-training foundation models.

摘要（中文）：仿真可以扩展稀缺的真实演示以用于协同训练，然而世界保真度和与人类行为的相似性如何影响策略性能仍不清楚。我们区分了世界接地（使仿真与真实系统对齐）和行为接地（使仿真轨迹与人类运动对齐）。我们构建了一个真实到仿真再到真实的流水线，该流水线独立改变这些维度以生成用于协同训练的数据。在一个动态灵巧抓取分拣任务中，完全接地的协同训练将成功率从52%提升至86%；在所有配置中取平均，世界接地使成功率提高18个百分点，行为接地则提高10个百分点。部署后的策略表现类似于真实衍生策略与仿真衍生策略的混合体，在覆盖状态下模仿真实演示，在其他状态下依赖仿真行为，我们通过潜在空间分析对此进行了考察。这些结果共同揭示了互补作用：世界接地使策略能够在真实数据覆盖范围之外利用仿真经验，而行为接地主要在世界接地不完善时发挥作用。在协同训练基础模型时，接地仿真仍然是有益的。

Authors: Samuel Liu, Youngsun Kim, Martin Matak, Gilwoo Lee

DITTO-X: Forward and Reverse Teleoperation for Dexterous Manipulation and Human Intervention Manipulation

dexterous teleoperation force feedback reverse teleoperation shared autonomy contact-rich manipulation

简要说明：DITTO-X是一种与手无关的灵巧遥操作接口，提供力与接触反馈并支持反向遥操作，在接触丰富的操作任务中提升了演示质量和策略部署期间的人工干预效果。

TLDR: DITTO-X is a hand-agnostic dexterous teleoperation interface that provides force and contact feedback and supports reverse teleoperation, improving demonstration quality and intervention during policy deployment for contact-rich manipulation tasks.

Abstract: Teleoperated demonstrations are a primary source of data for robot manipulation, and teleoperated interventions are a primary mechanism for correcting policies at deployment. Yet most teleoperation systems close the loop through vision alone and are built around parallel-jaw grippers, limiting both what the robot can execute and what the operator can express through it. This is most damaging in shared autonomy, where the operator sees the scene only through occluded cameras and must take over a dexterous hand mid-task, often with an object already grasped. We present DITTO-X, a hand-agnostic dexterous teleoperation interface that renders joint-level force and fingertip contact events from sensing already on the robot hand, and drives three commercial dexterous hands (Sharpa, Wuji, and Inspire) without per-hand redesign. Because the exoskeleton is actuated, DITTO-X also supports reverse teleoperation, in which the robot back-drives the operator's fingers into its own configuration before control is transferred, so the human enters the loop already matched to the state they inherit. Our results show that DITTO-X improves demonstration quality and throughput over a commercial hand-tracking glove, both in regular data collection and in human intervention during policy deployment for contact-rich manipulation tasks. More information can be found from our website: https://tml.stanford.edu/ditto-x/.

摘要（中文）：远程操作演示是机器人操控数据的主要来源，而远程操作干预则是部署过程中纠正策略的主要机制。然而，大多数远程操作系统仅通过视觉闭环，并围绕平行钳口夹爪构建，这既限制了机器人能执行的任务，也限制了操作者通过系统所能表达的动作。这一问题在共享自治系统中尤为严重，操作者仅能通过被遮挡的摄像头观察场景，并须在任务进行中接管灵巧手，且此时往往已抓取物体。我们提出了DITTO-X，一种与手型无关的灵巧远程操作接口，它利用机器人手部已有的传感信息生成关节级力与指尖接触事件，并驱动三款商用灵巧手（Sharpa、Wuji和Inspire），无需针对每款手进行重新设计。由于外骨骼是主动驱动的，DITTO-X还支持反向远程操作，即在控制权转移前，机器人将操作者的手指反向驱动至其自身构型，从而使操作者在进入回路时已与其接管的机器人状态对齐。实验结果表明，在常规数据采集以及策略部署过程中针对接触密集操控任务的人工干预这两种场景下，DITTO-X相较于商用手部追踪手套均显著提升了演示质量与效率。更多信息请访问我们的网站：https://tml.stanford.edu/ditto-x/。

Authors: Zhanpeng He, Joaquin Palacios, Zhangyu Wang, Chenhao Li, Katelyn Lee, Matei Ciocarlie, C. Karen Liu, Jiajun Wu

Reward as Observation: Learning Reward-Based Policies for Rapid Adaptation RLRobot

reward-based policy zero-shot transfer robot navigation adaptation

简要说明：本文提出一种仅基于奖励和动作的奖励策略，实现在完全不同观测空间环境间的零样本适应，并在多个环境及机器人导航中验证。

TLDR: This paper proposes a reward-based policy conditioned only on rewards and actions, enabling zero-shot adaptation to environments with completely different observation spaces, demonstrated across Pointmass, Cartpole, 2D Car Racing, and Stretch robot navigation in Habitat-Sim.

Abstract: This paper explores a reward-based policy to achieve zero-shot transfer between source and target environments with completely different observation spaces. While humans can demonstrate impressive adaptation capabilities, deep neural network policies often struggle to adapt to a new environment and require a considerable amount of samples for successful transfer. Instead, we propose a novel reward-based policy only conditioned on rewards and actions, enabling zero-shot adaptation to new environments with completely different observations. We discuss the challenges and feasibility of a reward-based policy and then propose a practical algorithm for training. We demonstrate that a reward policy can be trained within three different environments, Pointmass, Cartpole, and 2D Car Racing, and transferred to completely different observations, such as different color palettes or 3D rendering, or Stretch robot navigation in Habitat-Sim, in a zero-shot manner. We also demonstrate that a reward-based policy can further guide the training of an observation-based policy in the target environment.

摘要（中文）：本文探讨了一种基于奖励的策略，旨在实现观测空间完全不同的源环境与目标环境之间的零样本迁移。尽管人类能够展现出令人印象深刻的适应能力，深度神经网络策略却往往难以适应新环境，并且成功迁移需要大量的样本。为此，我们提出了一种新颖的仅基于奖励和动作的奖励策略，使其能够在对观测完全不同的新环境中实现零样本适应。我们讨论了基于奖励策略所面临的挑战及其可行性，并提出了一种实用的训练算法。我们证明了该奖励策略可以在三种不同环境（Pointmass、Cartpole和2D赛车）中进行训练，并以零样本方式迁移到完全不同的观测条件下，如不同的调色板、3D渲染，或Habitat-Sim中的Stretch机器人导航。我们还证明了基于奖励的策略能够进一步指导目标环境中基于观测的策略的训练。

Authors: Morgan Byrd, Maks Sorokin, Robert Wright, Sehoon Ha

CF-JEPA: Improving Robustness of JEPA World Models via Controllability Factorization WorldModel

JEPA world model controllability factorization robustness distractor robustness

简要说明：CF-JEPA 提出了一种具有可控性分解的 JEPA 风格世界模型，将潜在表示分为可控和不可控子空间，从而提升了在分散干扰下的鲁棒性并避免了潜在坍缩，在2D/3D和仿真机器人任务中得到验证。

TLDR: CF-JEPA introduces a JEPA-style world model with a controllability factorization that separates latent representations into controllable and uncontrollable subspaces, improving robustness to distractors and preventing latent collapse in 2D/3D and simulated robot control tasks.

Abstract: Controlling an agent with vision requires being able to separate useful information from irrelevant background information. JEPA-style latent world models seem like a natural approach for this, as they do not perform pixel-level reconstruction; however, they are still sensitive to these distractor signals and experience latent collapse. In this work, we introduce Controllability Factorized JEPA (CF-JEPA), a JEPA-style world model which splits the latent space into controllable and uncontrollable subspaces. This factorization allows us to capture all the distractor information into the uncontrollable region, while we use the control-relevant latent information for our task. With this, we show comparable performance across 2D and 3D control tasks under nominal conditions and improved performance under distracted conditions, where CF-JEPA is the only model that does not experience latent collapse. We also validate our model under distracted conditions for a simulated robot task, highlighting the practical application of such a scheme.

摘要（中文）：操控一个具备视觉的智能体，需要能够将有用的信息与无关的背景信息分离开来。JEPA式的潜在世界模型似乎是实现这一目标的自然方法，因为它们不进行像素级别的重建；然而，它们仍然对这些干扰信号敏感，并经历潜在塌缩。在本研究中，我们引入了可控性因子分解JEPA（CF-JEPA），这是一种JEPA式的世界模型，它将潜在空间划分为可控与不可控的子空间。这种分解使我们能够将所有干扰信息捕获到不可控区域，同时利用与控制相关的潜在信息来执行任务。通过这种方式，我们展示了在标称条件下，该模型在2D和3D控制任务上具有相当的性能，并且在存在干扰的条件下性能更佳，其中CF-JEPA是唯一没有经历潜在塌缩的模型。我们还在存在干扰的条件下，对一个模拟机器人任务进行了模型验证，凸显了此类方案的实际应用价值。

Authors: Morgan Byrd, Robert Wright, Sehoon Ha

TacDyn-WAM: Learning Implicit Tactile Dynamics in a Heterogeneous Visuo-Tactile World Action Model WorldModel

world action model tactile dynamics implicit prediction manipulation visuo-tactile

简要说明：TacDyn-WAM 提出了一种异构视觉-触觉世界动作模型，通过预测隐式触觉动力学而非重建未来触觉观测，在 UniVTAC 和真实机器人任务上取得了先进性能。

TLDR: TacDyn-WAM introduces a heterogeneous visuo-tactile world action model that predicts implicit tactile dynamics instead of reconstructing future tactile observations, achieving state-of-the-art performance on UniVTAC and real-robot tasks.

Abstract: World action models improve robotic manipulation by conditioning actions on predicted futures, yet existing tactile variants largely inherit video-generation pipelines that reconstruct future tactile observations through iterative denoising. Such prediction can become unreliable under deployment drift: small changes in contact position or force may substantially alter tactile pixels even when the underlying contact evolution remains predictable. We introduce TacDyn-WAM, a heterogeneous visuo-tactile world action model that predicts implicit tactile dynamics rather than reconstructing future tactile observations. It learns TacRep, a dynamics-aware tactile target space trained through masked spatio-temporal prediction on tactile clips and regularized by relational structure distillation. A visual expert and an Implicit Tactile Dynamics Expert predict future visual and tactile representations in separate target spaces while interacting through joint attention; the tactile expert predicts future representations and their changes at multiple horizons in a single forward pass, and a read-only tactile memory supplies the current tactile state. On UniVTAC, TacDyn-WAM achieves an average success rate of 81.5% using only the provided demonstrations, reaching state-of-the-art-level performance and remaining competitive with models pretrained on large-scale visuo-tactile trajectories. Ablations confirm the benefits of both tactile pathways and TacRep over pixel-reconstruction and static alternatives. On five real-robot tasks, TacDyn-WAM reaches 71.0% average success, and modest-scale pretraining raises it to 85.0%, further validating our method.

摘要（中文）：世界动作模型通过基于预测的未来状态来调节动作，从而提升机器人操作能力，然而现有的触觉变体大多继承了视频生成流程，通过迭代去噪重建未来的触觉观测。这类预测在部署漂移下可能变得不可靠：接触位置或力的微小变化可能显著改变触觉像素，即便潜在的接触演化仍是可预测的。我们提出TacDyn-WAM，一种异质视觉-触觉世界动作模型，它预测隐式触觉动态而非重建未来触觉观测。该模型学习TacRep，一种动态感知的触觉目标空间，通过对触觉片段进行掩码时空预测训练，并通过关系结构蒸馏加以正则化。一个视觉专家模块与一个隐式触觉动态专家模块在各自的目标空间中预测未来的视觉与触觉表示，同时通过联合注意力机制相互作用；触觉专家模块在单次前向传播中预测多个时间尺度上的未来表示及其变化，而一个只读触觉记忆模块提供当前触觉状态。在UniVTAC上，TacDyn-WAM仅使用所提供的演示即可达到81.5%的平均成功率，达到当前最优水平，并能与在大规模视觉-触觉轨迹上预训练的模型保持竞争力。消融实验证实了触觉通路和TacRep相较于像素重建及静态替代方案的优势。在五项真实机器人任务中，TacDyn-WAM达到71.0%的平均成功率，而适度规模的预训练将其提升至85.0%，进一步验证了我们的方法。

Authors: Enyi Wang, Mingxin Wang, Quan Shi, Hetian Guo, Hongyu Wang, Xi Wang, Bin Qian, Yupeng Zheng, Wenxuan Song, Houde Liu, Yong Xu, Cheng Chi, Wenchao Ding, Yilun Chen, Yan Wang

MIKASA-Robo-VLA: Benchmarking Memory in VLA Models for Long-Horizon Manipulation VLA

VLA benchmark long-horizon manipulation memory language-conditioned oracle trajectories

简要说明：本文提出了MIKASA-Robo-VLA基准，包含90个语言条件操纵任务，旨在评估VLA模型在长期任务中的记忆能力，并提供了部分任务的基线结果。

TLDR: This paper introduces MIKASA-Robo-VLA, a benchmark of 90 language-conditioned manipulation tasks designed to evaluate memory in VLA models for long-horizon tasks, and provides baseline results on a subset of tasks.

Abstract: Vision-language-action policies often see only one or a few recent frames, which makes it difficult to evaluate how they use information that disappears during a task. We introduce MIKASA-Robo-VLA, a benchmark of 90 language-conditioned manipulation tasks. All but 10 hide the cue an action depends on. Those 10 are reactive controls. MIKASA-Robo, the suite it rebuilds, has 32 tasks and uses language only in a representative VLA subset. Here every task provides an instruction, while memory-dependent tasks hide a task-relevant cue and reactive controls keep it available. For 70 tasks, environment phase timings specify an information gap, and for 28 of them the gap exceeds the 16-frame window of the widest fixed-context VLA we survey. The gap counts only the interval the cue is provably absent, not the full duration a policy must retain it, so every memory-dependent task still requires memory by construction, including the ones whose measured gap is short. We release 22,500 oracle trajectories across 10 memory types in RLDS and LeRobotDataset v3. A reference $π_{0.5}$ baseline with current images and proprioception, but no observation history or explicit memory module, is fine-tuned on 14 tasks and achieves 0.211 $\pm$ 0.044 mean task success. Its lower success on the evaluated Long-split tasks is confounded by open-loop chunking and the memory types represented in that subset. Project page: https://mikasarobo.github.io/

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作策略通常仅观察一至数个近期帧，这使得评估它们如何利用在任务过程中消失的信息变得困难。我们提出了MIKASA-Robo-VLA，一个包含90项语言条件操控任务的基准测试集。其中除10项外的所有任务均隐藏了动作所依赖的线索，而那10项为反应控制任务。该基准所重建的MIKASA-Robo套件包含32项任务，且仅在具有代表性的VLA子集中使用语言。在本基准中，每项任务都提供指令，而记忆依赖任务隐藏与任务相关的线索，反应控制任务则保持线索可见。对于70项任务，环境阶段的时序设定了信息间隔，其中28项任务的间隔超过了我们所调查的最宽固定上下文VLA的16帧窗口。该间隔仅计算线索可证明不存在的时段，而非策略必须保留线索的完整持续时间，因此每项记忆依赖任务在构造上仍然需要记忆，包括那些测量间隔较短的任务。我们发布了跨越10种记忆类型的22，500条专家轨迹，格式为RLDS和LeRobotDataset v3。一个参考$π_{0.5}$基线使用当前图像和本体感觉，但不具备观察历史或显式记忆模块，在14项任务上进行微调，实现了0.211 $\pm$ 0.044的平均任务成功率。其在所评估的Long-split任务子集上较低的成功率受到开环分块及该子集中所包含记忆类型的混淆影响。项目页面：https://mikasarobo.github.io/

Authors: Egor Cherepanov, Nikita Kachaev, Aleksandr I. Panov, Alexey K. Kovalev

When Reasoning Helps Action: Monitoring and Steering Chain-of-Thought in Vision-Language-Action Policies VLA

chain-of-thought vision-language-action reasoning monitoring value model runtime safety

简要说明：本文提出了TRUST，一种离线训练的价值模型，用于监控和引导冻结的VLA策略中的思维链推理，在驾驶任务中提高了推理正确性并降低了碰撞率，但在操作任务中的闭环性能提升有限。

TLDR: This paper introduces TRUST, an offline-trained value model that monitors and steers chain-of-thought reasoning in frozen VLA policies, improving reasoning correctness and reducing collision rate in driving while showing limited closed-loop gains in manipulation.

Abstract: Reasoning-enabled VLA policies expose chain-of-thought (CoT) traces that appear to explain and guide their actions, creating a potential interface for runtime safety through reasoning monitoring and correction. In this work, we define and operationalize two evaluation axes for assessing when this interface can improve embodied behavior: correctability, which measures whether unreliable reasoning can be detected and improved during generation, and actionability, which measures whether reasoning corrections produce behaviorally meaningful changes in the intended direction. To enable correctability, we introduce Token-level Reward for Utility-Steered Chain-of-Thought (TRUST), an offline-trained value model that predicts eventual reasoning correctness from partial prefixes and uses these estimates to monitor and selectively steer reasoning generation in frozen VLA policies. On the Alpamayo 1.5 driving VLA, TRUST monitors correctness with 88.9% accuracy and improves reasoning correctness from 75.9% to 90.0%. On a baseline-defined challenging subset in AlpaSim, TRUST reduces collision rate by 30.4% and maximum trajectory error by 11.5% relative to the unsteered policy, outperforming a compute-matched Best-of-4 baseline. On the DeepThinkVLA manipulation VLA, TRUST improves the correctness of grasp-state claims from 69.3% to 90.2% and action-choice claims from 68.8% to 85.9%, yet closed-loop task performance on LIBERO-Plus remains largely unchanged. Empirical analysis reveals intent-consistent behavioral effects in Alpamayo 1.5 but limited effects in DeepThinkVLA, helping interpret these different task-level outcomes. Together, our results show that gains in reasoning correctness do not automatically imply gains in embodied performance, motivating evaluation of correctability and actionability when using CoT as a runtime safety interface.

摘要（中文）：具备推理能力的视觉-语言-行动（VLA）策略会暴露其思维链（CoT）轨迹，这些轨迹看似解释并引导了其行为，从而为通过推理监控与修正实现运行时安全提供了潜在接口。在本工作中，我们定义并操作化两个评估维度，用以衡量该接口何时能够改善具身行为：可修正性（correctability），即检测不可靠推理并在生成过程中加以改进的能力；以及可行动性（actionability），即推理修正能否在预期方向上产生具有行为意义的改变。为实现可修正性，我们引入了面向效用导向思维链的令牌级奖励（Token-level Reward for Utility-Steered Chain-of-Thought，简称TRUST），这是一种离线训练的价值模型，能够从部分前缀预测最终推理正确性，并利用这些估计对冻结的VLA策略中的推理生成进行监控和选择性引导。在Alpamayo 1.5驾驶VLA上，TRUST以88.9%的准确率监控推理正确性，并将推理正确性从75.9%提升至90.0%。在AlpaSim中基于基线定义的挑战性子集上，TRUST相较于未引导策略将碰撞率降低了30.4%，最大轨迹误差降低了11.5%，优于计算资源匹配的Best-of-4基线。在DeepThinkVLA操作VLA上，TRUST将抓取状态断言的正确性从69.3%提升至90.2%，动作选择断言的正确性从68.8%提升至85.9%，然而在LIBERO-Plus上的闭环任务性能基本保持不变。实证分析揭示了Alpamayo 1.5中意图一致的行为效应，而DeepThinkVLA中的效应有限，这有助于解释不同的任务级结果。综合来看，我们的结果表明，推理正确性的提升并不自动意味着具身性能的提升，这促使在将思维链作为运行时安全接口时，有必要对可修正性和可行动性进行评估。

Authors: Sathwik Karnik, Joseph JR. Lee, Aryaman Gupta, Somil Bansal

Token-World: World Modeling in Vision-Language Model Token Space for Robot Manipulation VLA

world model vision-language-action model token compression robot manipulation closed-loop simulation

简要说明：Token-World 提出了一种动作条件世界模型，将 VLM 视觉标记压缩为紧凑状态，在该缩减空间中学习未来动态，并将预测映射回策略表示，用于机器人操作，提高了仿真保真度和闭环策略性能相关性。

TLDR: Token-World introduces an action-conditioned world model that compresses VLM visual tokens into a compact state, learns future dynamics in this reduced space, and maps predictions back for robot manipulation, improving simulation fidelity and closed-loop correlation with policy performance.

Abstract: A common approach to world-model simulation for vision-language-action (VLA) systems is to predict future RGB observations and then re-encode them into policy inputs, introducing an indirect interface between simulation and downstream policy execution. We instead investigate whether world dynamics can be modeled in a compact, policy-oriented state derived from VLM visual tokens. A key challenge is that raw VLM visual tokens are high-dimensional, making efficient and accurate autoregressive dynamics modeling challenging. To address this, we introduce Token-World, an action-conditioned world model that compresses VLM features into a compact token state, learns future dynamics in this reduced space, and maps predicted states back to the original policy-facing representation for downstream use. Across manipulation benchmarks, Token-World improves open-loop feature fidelity and policy-action consistency over recent world-model simulators, with slower degradation over long rollout horizons. In closed-loop evaluation, its simulated policy performance correlates more strongly with reference policy performance than Ctrl-World ($r=0.794$ vs.\ $0.583$), while requiring lower simulation latency. Ablations further show that compact-representation design and dimensionality substantially affect future-state prediction. Code will be available at https://chuyaofu.github.io/Token-World/.

摘要（中文）：针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）系统的世界模型仿真，一种常见方法是预测未来的RGB观测，然后将其重新编码为策略输入，从而在仿真与下游策略执行之间引入间接接口。相反，我们研究是否可以在由VLM视觉标记导出的紧凑、面向策略的状态中建模世界动态。一个关键挑战在于，原始的VLM视觉标记维度较高，使得高效且准确的自回归动态建模颇具难度。为解决这一问题，我们提出了Token-World，一种动作条件世界模型，它将VLM特征压缩为紧凑的标记状态，在此降维空间中学习未来动态，并将预测状态映射回原始的策略面向表示以供下游使用。在多个操作基准测试中，Token-World在开环特征保真度和策略动作一致性方面优于近期世界模型仿真器，且在长程推演中退化更慢。在闭环评估中，其仿真策略性能与参考策略性能的相关性显著强于Ctrl-World（$r=0.794$ 对比 $0.583$），同时仿真延迟更低。消融实验进一步表明，紧凑表示设计和维度对未来状态预测有显著影响。代码将发布于 https://chuyaofu.github.io/Token-World/。

Authors: Chuyao Fu, Xiaowei Chi, Yuhan Rui, Yu-kai Wang, Zezhong Qian, Xiaojie Zhang, Yunfan Lou, Kevin Zhang, Kuangzhi Ge, Chak Wing Mak, Zhiyang Chen, Athena Zhuoming Zhong, Hongyang Chen, Haoran Li, Yike Guo, Sirui Han, Shanghang Zhang

Fewer Tokens, Better Action: GPT-6 Astra Robot Agents with 14% Higher Success Rate but 65% Fewer Tokens VLA

code-execution framework selective observation primitive composition VLM agent token efficiency

简要说明：本文提出了PyRUA-Lean，一种用于VLM驱动的机器人代理的代码执行框架，通过结合反馈驱动的原语组合和选择性观察来减少令牌开销，在多个模拟基准上以更少的令牌实现了更高的成功率。

TLDR: This paper introduces PyRUA-Lean, a code-execution framework for VLM-driven robot agents that reduces token overhead by coupling feedback-driven primitive composition with selective observation, achieving higher success rates with fewer tokens across simulated benchmarks.

Abstract: Vision language model (VLM) agents can control robots through visual feedback and action primitives, but repeated model invocations and redundant observations incur substantial token overhead. We introduce PyRUA-Lean, an interactive code-execution framework that couples feedback-driven primitive composition with selective observation: the agent composes classical robot primitives and learned vision-language-action (VLA) policies into Python cells that perform conditional checks and local retries, returning only explicitly requested images and state feedback for replanning. Across 700 simulated task instances from LIBERO-PRO, RoboTwin 2.0, and RoboCasa365, we compare PyRUA-Lean with a tool-calling baseline using the same GPT-6 Astra planner and underlying robot primitives. Under equal LLM-call budgets, PyRUA-Lean increases overall success from 63.1% to 71.7%. On instances solved by both agents, it uses 49% fewer LLM calls and 65% fewer input tokens.

摘要（中文）：视觉语言模型（VLM）智能体能够通过视觉反馈和动作原语控制机器人，但反复的模型调用和冗余的观测会造成大量的令牌开销。我们提出了PyRUA-Lean，一种交互式代码执行框架，将反馈驱动的原语组合与选择性观测相结合：智能体将经典机器人原语和习得的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略组合成Python单元，这些单元可执行条件检查和局部重试，仅返回显式请求的图像和状态反馈以用于重新规划。在来自LIBERO-PRO、RoboTwin 2.0和RoboCasa365的700个模拟任务实例中，我们使用相同的GPT-6 Astra规划器和底层机器人原语，将PyRUA-Lean与一个工具调用基线进行了比较。在相同的LLM调用预算下，PyRUA-Lean将整体成功率从63.1%提升至71.7%。在两个智能体均解决的任务实例上，它使用的LLM调用次数减少了49%，输入令牌数量减少了65%。

Authors: Ruiyang Si, Jianxin Bi, Shunyu Yang, Rui Ni, Wenbo Huang, Qiang Wang, Shulong Jiang, Duomin Wang, Xiuyu Li, Haiwen Feng, Zhen Dong, Daquan Zhou

MapLightning: Online Vectorized HD Map Construction with 1D Map Tokens AutonomousDriving

vectorized HD map 1D map tokens self-attention autonomous driving trajectory prediction

简要说明：MapLightning 使用紧凑的 1D 可学习地图标记和全自注意力在线构建矢量化高清地图，替代密集 BEV 网格，在 nuScenes 和 Argoverse 2 上实现了最先进的精度、更快的推理速度和更低的内存占用，同时改进了不确定性估计和下游轨迹预测。

TLDR: MapLightning constructs vectorized HD maps online using compact 1D learnable map tokens and full self-attention, replacing dense BEV grids to achieve state-of-the-art accuracy, faster inference, and lower memory on nuScenes and Argoverse 2, while also improving uncertainty estimation and downstream trajectory prediction.

Abstract: Online vectorized HD map construction is essential for scaling safe autonomous driving and requires accurate, real-time inference. Prior methods typically rely on dense bird's-eye-view (BEV) grids as the intermediate representation. We propose \textit{MapLightning}, which replaces the dense BEV grid with a compact set of 1D learnable map tokens. To construct map tokens from image features, we choose self-attention over vanilla cross-attention because it enables joint interactions and contextual aggregation among image and map tokens. Our transformer-based mapper concatenates map and image tokens, applies full self-attention, discards the image tokens, and retains the updated map tokens for decoding. This design offers three advantages. First, our representation is efficient, using fewer tokens, consuming less memory, and running faster. Second, the lightweight design allows the map decoder to use full rather than deformable cross-attention for better global context. Third, unlike BEV-based methods, our network does not use camera projection parameters, making it robust to camera-extrinsic perturbations. MapLightning uses up to 16.7$\times$ fewer intermediate tokens than dense BEV-based methods and achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and efficiency on nuScenes and Argoverse~2. Its lightweight variant surpasses MapTRv2 by +10.1 mAP on nuScenes and +16.2 mAP on Argoverse~2, while delivering 1.73$\times$ faster inference (40+ FPS) with 53\% less memory. We further show improvements on uncertainty-aware map construction and downstream trajectory prediction. Code and models will be released.

摘要（中文）：在线矢量化高清地图构建对于扩展安全的自动驾驶至关重要，需要准确且实时的推理。现有方法通常依赖密集的鸟瞰图（BEV）网格作为中间表示。我们提出\textit{MapLightning}，用一组紧凑的一维可学习地图令牌替代密集的BEV网格。为了从图像特征构建地图令牌，我们选择自注意力而非普通交叉注意力，因为它能够实现图像令牌与地图令牌之间的联合交互和上下文聚合。我们基于Transformer的地图构建器将地图令牌和图像令牌拼接，应用完整的自注意力，丢弃图像令牌，并保留更新后的地图令牌用于解码。该设计具有三个优势。第一，我们的表示高效，使用更少的令牌，消耗更少的内存，运行速度更快。第二，轻量级设计使地图解码器能够使用完整的而非可变形交叉注意力，以获得更好的全局上下文。第三，与基于BEV的方法不同，我们的网络不使用相机投影参数，因此对相机外参扰动具有鲁棒性。MapLightning使用的中间令牌数量比基于密集BEV的方法最多减少16.7$\times$，并在nuScenes和Argoverse~2上实现了最先进的准确性和效率。其轻量级变体在nuScenes上比MapTRv2高出+10.1 mAP，在Argoverse~2上高出+16.2 mAP，同时推理速度提高了1.73$\times$（40+ FPS），内存占用减少53\%。我们进一步展示了在不确定性感知地图构建和下游轨迹预测方面的改进。代码和模型将公开发布。

Authors: Shen Zheng, Anurag Ghosh, Mani Ramanagopal, Srinivasa Narasimhan

Oneira: From Open-Ended Generation to Open-World Interaction in Video World Models WorldModel

interactive video world model world state coding agent open-world interaction persistent state

简要说明：Oneira 提出了一种交互式视频世界模型，通过编码代理管理显式世界状态，实现对新增生成对象的直接交互以及长期交互结果的持续保持。

TLDR: Oneira introduces an interactive video world model that manages an explicit world state via a coding agent, enabling open-world interaction with newly generated objects and persistent state changes over long horizons.

Abstract: Generative video world models can now synthesize open-ended environments that agents can navigate and interact with in simple ways. Yet open-ended generation does not imply full interaction: as a generated world expands, newly created content through navigation should expand what the agent can act upon, and as the agent changes the world, those changes should become persistent parts of the environment rather than transient visual effects. We characterize these two requirements as Open-World Interactivity, where newly generated or encountered entities are incorporated into the actionable world, and Persistent State, where interaction outcomes are committed to the world state and continue to influence subsequent observations and interactions. We present Oneira, an interactive video world model that closes the loop between generation and interaction through an explicit, extensible world state managed by a coding agent. Given the current observation and an action or high-level goal, the agent reads the world state, grounds the relevant entities, plans the interaction, and writes its outcome back into a world state table. When exploration reveals new objects, the agent incorporates them from generated observations, allowing the interaction space to expand with the generated world. Meanwhile, previously induced state changes are carried across video segments, making the consequences of interaction persistent parts of subsequent world evolution. The updated world state is rendered along the camera action trajectory into a coarse conditioning video, from which a video generator fills in the appearance, motion, and interaction details not represented in the state. Experiments show that Oneira enables direct and consistent interaction with newly generated objects, while preserving the effects of prior interactions over long horizons. Project page: https://madaoer.github.io/projects/oneira

摘要（中文）：生成式视频世界模型现在能够合成开放式的环境，智能体可以在其中以简单方式进行导航和交互。然而，开放式生成并不等同于完全交互：随着生成世界的扩展，通过导航新创建的内容应当扩展智能体可操作的范围；而当智能体改变世界时，这些改变应当成为环境的持久组成部分，而非短暂的视觉效果。我们将这两个要求分别定义为“开放世界交互性”（Open-World Interactivity），即新生成或遇到的实体被纳入可操作的世界中；以及“持久状态”（Persistent State），即交互结果被提交至世界状态，并持续影响后续的观察和交互。我们提出Oneira，一种交互式视频世界模型，通过由编码智能体管理的显式、可扩展的世界状态，实现生成与交互之间的闭环。给定当前观察和一个动作或高层目标，智能体读取世界状态，定位相关实体，规划交互，并将其结果写回世界状态表。当探索揭示新对象时，智能体从生成的观察中将其纳入，从而使交互空间随生成世界一同扩展。同时，先前引发的状态变化会跨视频片段传递，使交互后果成为后续世界演化的持久组成部分。更新后的世界状态沿相机动作轨迹被渲染为粗略的条件视频，视频生成器再据此填充状态中未表示的外观、运动和交互细节。实验表明，Oneira能够实现对新生成对象的直接且一致的交互，同时在长时间跨度内保持先前交互的效果。项目页面：https://madaoer.github.io/projects/oneira

Authors: Xindi Yang, Baolu Li, Liam Lee, Zhenfei Yin, Songxin Zhang, Zhuoyang Song, Xu Jia, Jianfei Cai, Tien-Tsin Wong, Bingyi Jing, Mengyue Yang

CtrlWAM: Controllable World Action Models with Aligned Intent and Foresight WorldModel

world action model controllable generation action-video alignment simulator-based training multi-agent control

简要说明：CtrlWAM通过在模拟器中执行扰动动作并配对相应的噪声视觉结果来改进世界动作模型，引入扭曲噪声调度和多智能体动作接口，提升了驾驶和机器人任务中的可控性。

TLDR: CtrlWAM improves world action models by executing perturbed actions in a simulator to create aligned action-video noise pairs, introducing warped noise schedules and multi-agent action interfaces for better controllability in driving and robotics.

Abstract: World action models (WAMs) jointly predict actions (intent) and visual future (foresight). Standard training adds noise to recorded actions and video simultaneously, but such training paradigms introduce a mismatch: perturbed actions imply counterfactual future visual, while the noised video remains tied to the GT recording. In low-noise regime, the scene geometry and even the dynamic behavior remain clearly visible from the noisy future frames despite the added noise. We present CtrlWAM, which executes perturbed actions in a simulator and pairs them with their noised visual consequences for joint WAM learning. To accommodate the different denoising requirements of video and actions, we introduce warped video--action noise schedules that aim to keep visual layout responsive as action predictions evolve. We further extend the action interface from ego-only control to a variable number of agent streams, allowing a unified model to represent predicted or commanded futures for multiple agents. Driving experiments show more accurate action forecasts, closer agreement between generated video and actions, and better following of supplied commands; robotics experiments show stronger motion fidelity and controllability. Matched controls support the benefit of off-path renders for command following and manipulation fidelity. Together, these findings contribute to a more controllable world action model. Project page: https://ctrl-wam.github.io/

摘要（中文）：世界动作模型（WAMs）联合预测动作（意图）与视觉未来（预见）。标准训练方式同时对记录的动作和视频添加噪声，但此类训练范式引入了一种不匹配：受扰动的动作意味着反事实的未来视觉，而加噪视频仍与真值记录保持一致。在低噪声条件下，尽管添加了噪声，场景几何结构甚至动态行为仍可从带噪的未来帧中清晰辨识。我们提出CtrlWAM，该方法在模拟器中执行受扰动的动作，并将其与对应的加噪视觉结果配对，以进行联合WAM学习。为适配视频与动作不同的去噪需求，我们引入了扭曲视频-动作噪声调度，旨在随着动作预测的演变保持视觉布局的响应性。我们进一步将动作接口从仅限自我控制扩展至可变数量的智能体流，使统一模型能够表示多个智能体的预测或指令化未来。驾驶实验表明，该方法实现了更精准的动作预测、生成视频与动作之间更高的一致性，以及更优的指令跟随能力；机器人实验则展示了更强的运动保真度与可控性。匹配对照实验支持离路径渲染对指令跟随与操作保真度的增益效果。综上所述，这些发现有助于构建更可控的世界动作模型。项目页面：https://ctrl-wam.github.io/

Authors: Chensheng Peng, Wenhao Ding, Ran Tian, Zewei Zhou, Jef Packer, Maximilian Igl, Peter Karkus, Yan Wang, Masayoshi Tomizuka, Boris Ivanovic, Marco Pavone, Yuxiao Chen

Memorizon: Training World Models Beyond Their Context Window WorldModel

world models streaming retrieval revisit consistency long-span supervision

简要说明：Memorizon 提出了一种流式世界模型的训练方法，通过共享的 top-K 检索潜变量库将监督跨度与注意力成本解耦，从而在不增加二次注意力成本的情况下训练长期一致性。

TLDR: Memorizon proposes a training method for streaming world models that decouples supervision span length from attention cost by using a shared bank of top-K retrieved latents, enabling long-span consistency training without quadratic attention.

Abstract: Streaming world models should render a place consistently across repeated visits. Directly supervising such revisits requires training samples that capture both visits, often spanning minutes. Yet dense attention over the full span incurs quadratic costs, making long-span supervision expensive. Memorizon breaks this coupling: long spans are needed for supervision, but not for attention, since the two visits can share a forward pass without including every intervening frame. A training sample covers a span of any length but is scored only on its last $k$ chunks. Instead of tokenizing the history before them, each scored chunk retrieves its own top-$K$ latents by camera co-visibility, and the union of these requests forms a shared bank. The bank is bounded by $kK$, so the sequence stays bounded however long the span; at the shortest span the recipe is exactly conventional training. Adding the bank raises the cost of a step once; beyond that, a longer span costs little, and going from 100 to 400 s adds 12% to the step time. Against a sliding-window baseline, retrieval raises revisit consistency on every split, and a span long enough to reach the first visit of each return adds a further 24% to 30%, at some cost in image quality; beyond that span, more length no longer helps. Filling the bank from another episode lowers revisit correlation by 83%, so the model uses what it retrieves. Project page: https://tingtingliao.github.io/memorizon

摘要（中文）：流式世界模型应在重复访问时保持一致的地点渲染。直接监督此类重访需要捕捉两次访问的训练样本，这些访问往往跨越数分钟。然而，对整个时间跨度进行密集注意力计算会产生二次方成本，使得长跨度监督代价高昂。Memorizon打破了这一耦合：长跨度仅用于监督，而非注意力计算，因为两次访问可以共享一次前向传播，而无需包含所有中间帧。一个训练样本可覆盖任意长度的跨度，但仅对其最后k个块进行评分。每个被评分的块并非将之前的全部历史进行分词处理，而是通过相机共视性检索其自身的top-K潜在表示，这些请求的并集构成一个共享记忆库。该记忆库的大小上限为kK，因此无论跨度多长，序列长度始终保持有界；在最短跨度下，该方案与常规训练完全一致。加入记忆库会使单步计算成本增加一次；在此之后，更长的跨度几乎不增加额外开销，从100秒延长至400秒仅使单步时间增加12%。与滑动窗口基线相比，检索在所有分割上都提升了重访一致性，而足以覆盖每次返回首次访问的跨度进一步将一致性提升24%至30%，但以一定的图像质量为代价；超出该跨度后，继续增加长度不再带来收益。从另一情节中填充记忆库会使重访相关性降低83%，这表明模型确实利用了所检索到的内容。项目页面：https://tingtingliao.github.io/memorizon

Authors: Tingting Liao, Xuezhi Liang, Hao Li, Guangyi Liu

Learning Commute-Time-Preserving World Models for Planning WorldModel

world models commute-time embeddings goal-conditioned planning self-supervised learning latent displacement

简要说明：本文提出了通勤时间保持世界模型（CTWMs），学习保持通勤时间的潜在表示用于目标条件规划，在连续目标到达基准上优于任务无关基线。

TLDR: This paper introduces Commute-Time-Preserving World Models (CTWMs), a latent world model that learns commute-time-preserving embeddings for goal-conditioned planning, demonstrating improvements over a task-agnostic baseline on continuous goal-reaching benchmarks.

Abstract: World models allow agents to plan in latent space by choosing a sequence of actions that most reduces the distance to a given goal state. Thus, planning can benefit from latent representations whose distances mirror commute-times in the environment. The spectral embedding space of the graph Laplacian provides such a representation, if it obeys a specific eigenvalue-dependent scaling. Unfortunately, instantiating the graph Laplacian is intractable in large, continuous environments. Self-supervised learning offers a natural route to such commute-time-preserving embeddings at scale. However, here we show that existing methods, which commonly encourage isotropic representations to prevent representational collapse, tend to degrade the "correct" eigenvalue-dependent scaling, leading to an inaccurate representation of commute times. To address this problem, we introduce Commute-Time-Preserving World Models (CTWMs), combining a latent displacement predictor and a log-determinant regularizer that prevents collapse, which provably recover the correctly scaled Laplacian representation under reversible deterministic dynamics and at the predictor's fixed point. In numerical simulations, CTWM matches or outperforms LeWM, a task-agnostic baseline, on several complex, continuous goal-reaching benchmarks, while using half the parameters.

摘要（中文）：世界模型使智能体能够在潜空间中通过选择一系列动作进行规划，从而最大程度地缩短与给定目标状态之间的距离。因此，规划可以受益于那些其距离反映环境中游走时间的潜在表征。图拉普拉斯算子的谱嵌入空间提供了这样一种表征，前提是它遵循特定的依赖于特征值的缩放。然而，在大型连续环境中实例化图拉普拉斯算子是难以实现的。自监督学习为在大规模场景下获得这种保持游走时间的嵌入提供了一条自然途径。然而，我们在此表明，现有方法通常鼓励各向同性的表征以防止表征坍缩，却往往破坏“正确的”依赖于特征值的缩放，导致游走时间的表征不准确。为解决这一问题，我们引入了保持游走时间的世界模型（CTWMs），结合了潜在位移预测器和防止坍缩的对数行列式正则化器，在可逆确定性动力学条件下及预测器的固定点处，可证明能够恢复正确缩放的拉普拉斯表征。在数值模拟中，CTWM在多个复杂的连续目标到达基准任务上，与任务无关的基线方法LeWM相比，表现持平或更优，同时仅使用其一半的参数。

Authors: Michael Hauri, Peter Buttaroni, Fabian A. Mikulasch, Friedemann Zenke

JEPA-TTT: Persistent Test-Time Training of Latent World Models for Planning under Dynamics Shifts WorldModel

test-time training latent world model dynamics shift planning self-supervised adaptation

简要说明：JEPA-TTT 通过在测试时进行持续的自我监督更新，使预训练的潜在世界模型适应动态变化，从而在连续控制环境中提升规划性能。

TLDR: JEPA-TTT adapts a pretrained latent world model at test time via persistent self-supervised updates, improving planning under dynamics shifts across continuous-control environments.

Abstract: World models enable agents to plan by predicting future states of the environment, but their predictions can become unreliable when test-time dynamics differ from those seen during training. We present JEPA-TTT, which adapts the latent dynamics predictor of a pretrained action-conditioned Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture world model throughout test time. Self-supervised updates accumulate across episodes, while the visual encoder and reward head remain fixed, preserving the pretrained representation and task objective. Planning requires neither a goal image nor online environment reward. JEPA-TTT uses dense replay, which forms prediction windows at every temporal offset, retains them in a growing buffer, and samples minibatches from that buffer for predictor updates. Across eight dynamics shifts in four continuous-control environments, JEPA-TTT improves planning on every shift. After 500 test-time episodes, it reduces autoregressive latent prediction error by 83% on average and improves planning performance by 153% over the frozen JEPA world model. These results show that persistent self-supervised test-time training can adapt a pretrained latent world model under changed dynamics.

摘要（中文）：世界模型使智能体能够通过预测环境的未来状态来进行规划，但当测试时的动态变化与训练期间所见不同时，其预测可能会变得不可靠。我们提出了JEPA-TTT，它在整个测试期间对预训练的动作条件联合嵌入预测架构世界模型的潜在动态预测器进行自适应调整。自监督更新在多个回合中累积，而视觉编码器和奖励头保持固定，从而保留预训练的表示和任务目标。规划既不需要目标图像，也不需要在线环境奖励。JEPA-TTT采用密集回放机制，在每个时间偏移处形成预测窗口，将其保留在不断增长的缓冲区中，并从该缓冲区中采样小批量数据进行预测器更新。在四个连续控制环境中的八种动态变化下，JEPA-TTT在每种变化下均提升了规划性能。经过500个测试回合后，它将自回归潜在预测误差平均降低了83%，并将规划性能相较于冻结的JEPA世界模型提升了153%。这些结果表明，持续的自我监督测试时训练能够在动态变化的情况下自适应预训练的潜在世界模型。

Authors: Zheyuan Zhang, Suyu Ye, Nakul Agarwal, Hossein Nourkhiz Mahjoub, Ehsan Moradi Pari, Daniel Khashabi, Tianmin Shu, Vaishnav Tadiparthi

Watch, Infer, Coordinate: Inferring Robot Partner Constraints for Zero-Shot Coordination Manipulation

zero-shot coordination constraint inference physical coupling manipulation robots

简要说明：提出了一个基准和推理方法，使机器人能够通过联合行为推断伙伴的物理约束，从而在操作任务中实现零样本协作。

TLDR: Introduces a benchmark and inference method for robots to infer a partner's physical constraints from joint behavior, enabling zero-shot coordination in manipulation tasks.

Abstract: Robots operating in the physical world will increasingly need to coordinate with other robots, particularly in manipulation tasks where an object may be too large or heavy for a single robot to carry alone. Physical limitations caused by hardware degradation or actuator faults can restrict the actions a robot can reliably execute, yet these limitations may be unknown to its partner. We study whether a helper can infer a robot partner's physical constraints from observing it coordinate with another robot, then use the inferred capability to coordinate with the same partner on a new task. This is difficult because a demonstration shows what the constrained robot did, but not what it could have done. In physically coupled tasks, the other robot may also compensate for its limitations, making those limitations difficult to identify from the constrained robot's behavior alone. Our key insight is that these constraints shape the joint behavior of the team, making the actions of both robots informative about the constrained partner's capability. We introduce Watch, Infer, Coordinate, a benchmark spanning three physically coupled manipulation settings, together with an inference approach that scores candidate constraints using observed joint behavior. Across all three settings, our method substantially improves constraint inference and zero-shot coordination, approaching an oracle with access to the true constraints.

摘要（中文）：在物理世界中运行的机器人将日益需要与其他机器人进行协调，尤其是在操作任务中，当物体过大或过重，单个机器人无法独立搬运时。由硬件退化或执行器故障导致的物理限制，可能限制机器人能够可靠执行的动作，然而这些限制对于其合作伙伴而言可能是未知的。我们研究的是，辅助机器人能否通过观察受限机器人与其他机器人的协调过程，推断出其物理限制，并随后利用这一推断出的能力，与同一合作伙伴在新任务上进行协调。这一任务的难点在于，演示只展示了受限机器人实际执行的动作，而未展示其可能执行的动作。在物理耦合任务中，另一机器人也可能对其局限性进行补偿，使得仅从受限机器人自身的行为中识别其限制变得困难。我们的核心见解在于，这些限制塑造了团队的整体行为，从而使两个机器人的动作都包含了关于受限合作伙伴能力的有效信息。我们提出了“观察、推断、协调”（Watch, Infer, Coordinate）框架，这是一个涵盖三种物理耦合操作场景的基准测试，并配套了一种推断方法，利用观测到的联合行为对候选限制进行评分。在所有三种场景中，我们的方法显著提升了限制推断和零样本协调的性能，接近了能够获取真实限制信息的理想基准。

Authors: Suyu Ye, Zheyuan Zhang, Vaishnav Tadiparthi, Hossein Nourkhiz Mahjoub, Ehsan Moradi Pari, Tianmin Shu, Homanga Bharadhwaj, Nakul Agarwal

H-SPAR: Hydrodynamic-aware Simulation for Particle Transport and Autonomous Robots Other

Lagrangian particle transport USV autonomy hydrodynamic-aware simulation path planning coverage sampling

简要说明：H-SPAR 是一个海洋机器人模拟器，集成了时变流场、拉格朗日粒子输运、概率采样和基于 ROS 2/Gazebo 的无人水面艇自主性，以在一致的水动力条件下联合评估路径规划、车辆执行和采样性能。

TLDR: H-SPAR is a marine robotics simulator that integrates time-varying flow fields, Lagrangian particle transport, probabilistic sampling, and ROS 2/Gazebo-based USV autonomy to jointly evaluate path planning, vehicle execution, and sampling performance under consistent hydrodynamic conditions.

Abstract: Environmental robotic sampling requires considering the dual influence of water currents on robotic motion and particle transport. Existing marine robotics simulators generally model flow, autonomy, and sampling targets separately, limiting joint evaluation of mission cost and sampling performance. H-SPAR integrates spatially and temporally varying velocity fields, Lagrangian particle transport, probabilistic sampling, and ROS 2/Gazebo-based uncrewed surface vehicle (USV) autonomy. In this work, shared precomputed flow fields drive particle advection and current-induced forces during closed-loop vehicle execution. Path-planning experiments show that the existing current-aware planner SVF-RRT* achieves 69.4% lower upstream cost than conventional RRT* at the planning level, but this reduction falls to 41.7% during execution under time-varying currents, reflecting temporal flow variation, vehicle motion constraints, and path deviation omitted during planning. Coverage experiments show that sweep orientation changes the particle-sampling rate by up to 22.2% under the complete H-SPAR configuration. These findings highlight the importance of evaluating planning, vehicle execution, particle transport, and sampling together under consistent hydrodynamic conditions. The project webpage is available at https://sites.google.com/view/h-spar, and the open-source code is available on GitHub at https://github.com/naviiidz/h-spar-sim.

摘要（中文）：环境机器人采样需要考虑水流对机器人运动和颗粒物输运的双重影响。现有海洋机器人仿真系统通常分别对水流、自主性和采样目标进行建模，限制了任务成本与采样性能的联合评估。H-SPAR集成了时空变化的流速场、拉格朗日颗粒输运、概率采样以及基于ROS 2/Gazebo的无人水面艇（USV）自主性。在本研究中，共享的预计算流场在闭环航行器执行过程中同时驱动颗粒物平流和流致作用力。路径规划实验表明，现有的水流感知规划算法SVF-RRT*在规划层面相比传统RRT*将逆流成本降低了69.4%，但在时变水流条件下执行时，该降幅降至41.7%，这反映了规划阶段未考虑的时变水流特征、航行器运动约束以及路径偏差。覆盖实验表明，在完整的H-SPAR配置下，扫描方向的变化会使颗粒物采样率产生最高22.2%的差异。这些发现凸显了在一致的水动力条件下联合评估规划、航行器执行、颗粒物输运和采样性能的重要性。项目网页见https://sites.google.com/view/h-spar，开源代码见GitHub：https://github.com/naviiidz/h-spar-sim。

Authors: Navid Zarrabi, Nariman Yousefi, Sajad Saeedi

ChunkVLA-AM: Parallel Action Chunking for Vision-Language-Action Robot Control in Additive Manufacturing VLA

Vision-Language-Action Action Chunking Additive Manufacturing OpenVLA Robot Manipulation

简要说明：本文提出了一个框架，将OpenVLA-OFT视觉-语言-动作模型部署在增材制造工作单元中的FAIRINO FR3机器人上，采用并行动作分块和云边架构。物理试验显示物体转移任务成功率为92.9%，并分析了光照对性能的影响。

TLDR: This paper presents a framework for deploying the OpenVLA-OFT vision-language-action model on a FAIRINO FR3 robot in an additive manufacturing workcell, using parallel action chunking and a cloud-edge architecture. Physical trials show a 92.9% success rate in object transfer tasks, with an analysis of illumination effects on performance.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models unify visual perception, language understanding, and action generation, offering new opportunities for automation in additive manufacturing (AM). However, deployment in AM remains challenging because adapting these models to unseen robot embodiments is costly, and performance can degrade under environment changes. In this work, we present a framework for deploying OpenVLA-OFT on a FAIRINO FR3 robot in a fixed AM workcell. A data pipeline converts monocular real-world demonstrations into OpenVLA-compatible TFDS/RLDS datasets to support adaptation to the FR3 embodiment. At runtime, each inference request predicts an eight-step chunk of 7-D actions. The FR3 executes each chunk open loop before capturing a new observation, providing closed-loop feedback between chunks. The system uses a cloud-edge architecture in which the FR3 client streams observations to a remote inference server through a FastAPI interface. In 42 physical A-to-B object-transfer trials, evenly split between red and blue targets, the system succeeded in 39 (92.9%). All three failures occurred during final placement, when insufficient release-height control caused the object to topple. An illumination sweep identified a low-error luminance range of 85-125 on a 0-255 scale, with the lowest mean spatial error at 95.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型统一了视觉感知、语言理解与动作生成，为增材制造（AM）领域的自动化带来了新机遇。然而，由于将这些模型适配至未见过的机器人本体成本高昂，且在环境变化时性能可能下降，其在实际应用中的部署仍面临挑战。本研究提出了一种框架，用于在固定增材制造工作单元中将OpenVLA-OFT部署至FAIRINO FR3机器人。所构建的数据管道将单目真实世界示范数据转换为兼容OpenVLA的TFDS/RLDS数据集，以支持对FR3本体的适配。在运行时，每次推理请求预测一个包含七维动作的八步动作块。FR3在执行完每个动作块后以开环方式运行，随后采集新的观测信息，从而在块间提供闭环反馈。该系统采用云-边架构，其中FR3客户端通过FastAPI接口将观测数据流式传输至远程推理服务器。在42次实际A到B物体搬运试验中（红、蓝目标各半），系统成功39次（成功率92.9%）。全部三次失败均发生在最终放置阶段，原因是释放高度控制不足导致物体倾倒。光照扫描实验确定了在0-255尺度上误差较低的亮度范围为85-125，其中平均空间误差最低点出现在亮度值95处。

Authors: Zhugang Liu, Kaichuang Zhang, Jinman Zhang, Pu Sun, Martha Asare, Jose Hernandez, Maxim Ermolinsky, Efren Saenz, Qi Lu, Jinghao Yang

FlashDexRetarget: Accelerating Dexterous Manipulation Data Generation through Multi-Motion Retargeting Manipulation

dexterous manipulation motion retargeting RL human hand-object demonstrations FlashSAC

简要说明：FlashDexRetarget 是一个基于强化学习的框架，用于将人手-物体演示高效重定向到机器人手部，在显著降低训练计算量的同时实现高成功率，并可扩展到大规模运动数据集。

TLDR: FlashDexRetarget is an RL-based framework for efficient dexterous motion retargeting from human hand-object demonstrations to robotic hands, achieving high success rates with significantly reduced training compute and scaling to large motion datasets.

Abstract: Human hand-object demonstrations offer a reusable source of dexterous robot manipulation data, but transferring them across embodiments requires physically feasible retargeting. Existing physics-based approaches face limitations in retargeting success, motion-specific training efficiency, or both. To address these limitations, we introduce FlashDexRetarget, an RL-based framework for high-success, efficient dexterous motion retargeting. To make the demonstrated interaction easier to learn, we combine object point-cloud observations, hand-object distance features, and future trajectory encodings with complementary rewards that supervise object motion and reference hand-object relationships. To further accelerate learning, we employ separate left- and right-hand actor critic networks and adapt the off-policy algorithm, FlashSAC to dexterous motion tracking. On a benchmark of 50 motions spanning single-object and two-object interactions, FlashDexRetarget achieves a 90% success rate, approximately 2.5x that of the evaluated sampling-based baselines, while requiring up to 100x less training compute than the evaluated RL-based baselines. Evaluations on both XHand and Sharpa Wave Hand show consistent gains, and component-wise ablations examine the contributions of our design choices. Beyond the 50-motion benchmark, experiments with 200, 500, and 1,000 motions demonstrate that our method remains stable at larger scales and produces successful retargeted motions more efficiently as the training set grows. Qualitative replay results using real-world-captured demonstrations further illustrate the applicability of our framework to recorded human manipulation. Videos and code are available at https://davian-robotics.github.io/FlashDexRetarget/

摘要（中文）：人类手物交互演示为灵巧机器人操作数据提供了可复用的来源，但跨实体迁移这些数据需要物理上可行的重定向。现有基于物理的方法在重定向成功率、特定动作训练效率或两者兼而有之方面存在局限。为解决这些局限，我们提出了FlashDexRetarget，一个基于强化学习的框架，用于实现高成功率、高效率的灵巧运动重定向。为使演示交互更易于学习，我们结合了物体点云观测、手物距离特征和未来轨迹编码，并辅以监督物体运动及参考手物关系的互补奖励。为进一步加速学习，我们采用独立的左手和右手演员-评论家网络，并将离策略算法FlashSAC适配到灵巧运动跟踪中。在涵盖单物体和双物体交互的50个动作基准测试中，FlashDexRetarget实现了90%的成功率，约为所评估的基于采样的基线方法的2.5倍，同时训练计算量比所评估的基于强化学习的基线方法最多减少100倍。在XHand和Sharpa Wave Hand上的评估均显示出一致的性能提升，组件消融实验检验了我们设计选择的贡献。在50个动作基准之外，使用200、500和1000个动作的实验表明，我们的方法在更大规模下保持稳定，且随着训练集的增长，能够更高效地生成成功的重定向动作。使用真实世界采集的演示进行的定性回放结果进一步展示了我们框架在记录的人类操作中的适用性。视频和代码可在https://davian-robotics.github.io/FlashDexRetarget/获取。

Authors: Kyungmin Lee, Sibeen Kim, Dongyoon Hwang, Yoonsang Oh, Donghu Kim, Youngdo Lee, I Made Aswin Nahrendra, Jaegul Choo, Hojoon Lee

End-to-End Learning vs. Modular Architectures: Comparative Insights into Autonomous Driving Systems AutonomousDriving

End-to-End Learning Modular Architectures Autonomous Driving Architecture Selection Framework Hybrid Approaches

简要说明：本文比较了自动驾驶中的端到端学习与模块化架构，提出了一个四维架构选择框架，并在十个已发表的系统上进行了验证。

TLDR: This paper compares end-to-end learning and modular architectures for autonomous driving, proposing a four-dimensional framework for selecting between them and validating it on ten published systems.

Abstract: Autonomous driving systems have become a central focus of intelligent transportation research, with End-to-End Learning and Modular Architectures offering two prominent design paradigms for their implementation. E2E Learning uses deep learning algorithms to map raw sensory inputs directly to driving actuators, providing a streamlined and adaptable solution. while Modular Architectures employ a pipeline-based approach, dividing the system into distinct subsystems for perception, cognition, planning, and control. This paper presents a comprehensive comparative analysis of these paradigms, focusing on their strengths, limitations, and trade-offs to provide insights into their suitability for various autonomous driving applications. The study evaluates key factors such as interpretability, scalability, robustness, and real-world applicability. While End-to-End Learning emphasizes simplicity and adaptability in dynamic environments, it lacks transparency and is highly dependent on large datasets. Conversely, Modular Architectures offer superior interpretability and task-specific optimization, but face challenges related to integration complexity and scalability. To address these limitations, hybrid approaches that combine the strengths of both paradigms have emerged, offering a promising direction for overcoming these challenges. Beyond this comparative synthesis, following work proposes a Four-Dimensional Architecture Selection Framework, comprising twelve binary criteria across safety, operating environment, data/computational resources, and deployment context, and validate it against ten published autonomous driving systems, correctly recommending 7/10 deployed architectures. This work synthesizes existing literature to highlight key trade-offs between the paradigms and identifies hybrid architectures as a promising direction for future research.

摘要（中文）：自主驾驶系统已成为智能交通研究的核心焦点，其中端到端学习与模块化架构为其实施提供了两种主流设计范式。端到端学习利用深度学习算法将原始传感器输入直接映射至驾驶执行器，提供了一种精简且适应性强的解决方案；而模块化架构则采用基于流水线的方式，将系统划分为感知、认知、规划与控制等不同子系统。本文对这两种范式进行了全面的比较分析，重点探讨其优势、局限及权衡关系，为它们在不同自主驾驶应用中的适用性提供见解。研究评估了可解释性、可扩展性、鲁棒性及实际应用性等关键因素。尽管端到端学习强调在动态环境中的简洁性与适应性，但其缺乏透明度且高度依赖大规模数据集。相比之下，模块化架构提供了更高的可解释性和任务特定优化能力，但面临集成复杂性与可扩展性方面的挑战。为应对这些局限，融合两种范式优势的混合方法应运而生，为克服上述挑战提供了有前景的方向。在此比较性综述的基础上，后续工作提出了一种四维架构选择框架，包含涵盖安全性、运行环境、数据/计算资源及部署情境的十二项二元标准，并将其应用于十个已发表的自主驾驶系统进行验证，成功推荐了其中7/10的已部署架构。本研究综合现有文献，突出了各范式之间的关键权衡，并指出混合架构是未来研究的一个有前景的方向。

Authors: Kartik B. Kapse

Query-Conditioned Articulation Estimation from a Single Image Manipulation

articulated object estimation single image robot manipulation query-conditioned mobile manipulator

简要说明：QueryArt 从单张RGB图像和2D查询点估计铰接物体的运动学参数，利用深度相对几何解决尺度模糊性，并在移动机械臂上展示了真实世界的操作能力。

TLDR: QueryArt estimates articulation parameters of articulated objects from a single RGB image and a 2D query point, using depth-relative geometry to handle scale ambiguity, and demonstrates real-world manipulation on a mobile manipulator.

Abstract: Enabling robots to estimate the kinematic parameters of articulated objects unlocks a wide range of capabilities for interaction and manipulation. The estimation has to happen from the information the robot currently observes, often just a single RGB image of an object it has never seen before. Current single-image approaches couple articulation part segmentation with articulation estimation, making their predictions vulnerable to missed detections and incorrect part associations, and they regress metric 3D geometry that a single view fixes only up to scale. We present QueryArt, a model that estimates articulation parameters from a single RGB image, a 2D query point, and camera intrinsics. QueryArt is trained to estimate the 3D articulation geometry relative to the queried point and in units of its depth, which keeps its target identifiable from the image alone. A single depth measurement at the query point then supplies the scale and recovers the metric parameters. We train QueryArt on a curated mixture of synthetic and real-world articulation datasets. We evaluate QueryArt on several benchmarks and compare it against recent baselines. QueryArt outperforms recent baselines on most articulation metrics, including on out-of-distribution data. To demonstrate the model's capabilities in real-world settings, we evaluate QueryArt on a mobile manipulator across 57 manipulation trials spanning 16 object parts and five viewpoint classes, achieving a 70.2% success rate. We provide code and videos at: https://abwerby.github.io/queryart/

摘要（中文）：使机器人能够估计铰接物体的运动学参数，将为其交互与操作解锁广泛的能力。这种估计必须基于机器人当前观测到的信息，而通常仅是一张从未见过物体的单一RGB图像。现有的单图像方法将铰接部分分割与铰接估计耦合在一起，使得其预测容易受到漏检和错误部分关联的影响，同时它们回归的度量3D几何结构在单视图下只能确定到尺度模糊的程度。我们提出了QueryArt，一种能够从单一RGB图像、一个2D查询点和相机内参中估计铰接参数的模型。QueryArt被训练为估计相对于查询点的3D铰接几何结构，并以该点的深度为单位，这使其目标仅凭图像即可被识别。查询点处的单一深度测量随后提供尺度信息并恢复度量参数。我们在精心混合的合成与真实世界铰接数据集上训练QueryArt，并在多个基准上对其进行评估，与近期基线方法进行比较。QueryArt在大多数铰接度量上优于近期基线方法，包括在分布外数据上也是如此。为展示该模型在真实世界场景中的能力，我们在移动机械臂上进行了57次操作试验，涵盖16个物体部件和5个视角类别，成功率达到70.2%。我们提供代码和视频：https://abwerby.github.io/queryart/

Authors: Abdelrhman Werby, Fabio Scaparro, Kai O. Arra

Learning a Resolution-Consistent Jacobian Field for Bio-Inspired Rigid-Soft Finger Manipulation

Jacobian Flow Matching tendon-driven finger Conditional Flow Matching ODE integration nonlinear system modeling

简要说明：本文提出了雅可比流匹配（JFM），一种基于条件流匹配的框架，用于学习腱驱动刚柔耦合手指的、分辨率一致的雅可比场，提高建模精度并实现跨时间分辨率的一致推理。

TLDR: This paper introduces Jacobian Flow Matching (JFM), a Conditional Flow Matching-based framework to learn a resolution-consistent Jacobian field for tendon-driven rigid-soft fingers, improving modeling accuracy and enabling consistent inference across temporal resolutions.

Abstract: Bio-inspired tendon-driven rigid-soft coupled dexterous fingers exhibit strong nonlinearity and configuration-dependent sensitivity, making accurate modeling challenging. In discrete-time control, Jacobian-based kinematic algorithms typically rely on point-wise local linear approximations, which makes their performance sensitive to sensor sampling frequency and controller update frequency. To address this issue, we propose Jacobian Flow Matching (JFM), a structured learning framework based on Conditional Flow Matching (CFM), to learn a resolution-consistent Jacobian field that models actuation-to-motion transitions as a dynamical flow. The proposed framework supports both single-step prediction and continuous rollout via ODE integration, enabling consistent inference across temporal resolutions. Experiments on a tendon-driven rigid-soft finger show that the proposed method suppresses outlier errors and improves single-step prediction accuracy, reducing the global average RMSE by over 53% compared with a baseline discrete Jacobian learning approach. For long-horizon prediction, trajectories recovered via ODE integration achieve higher fidelity under sparse sampling (Stride = 8), reducing the RMSE median by 14.43% and the error variance by 24.87%. These results demonstrate that the learned flow-based Jacobian field provides an effective local model for offline multi-step trajectory optimization in rigid-soft coupled nonlinear systems.

摘要（中文）：受生物启发的腱驱动刚柔耦合灵巧手指具有强非线性和构型相关的灵敏度，这使得精确建模充满挑战。在离散时间控制中，基于雅可比矩阵的运动学算法通常依赖逐点局部线性近似，因此其性能对传感器采样频率和控制器更新频率较为敏感。为解决该问题，我们提出了雅可比流匹配（JFM）方法，这是一种基于条件流匹配（CFM）的结构化学习框架，用于学习具有分辨率一致性的雅可比场，将驱动到运动的转换建模为动力学流。所提出的框架同时支持单步预测和通过常微分方程（ODE）积分实现的连续滚动推演，从而在不同时间分辨率下实现一致的推断。在腱驱动刚柔耦合手指上的实验表明，所提方法能够抑制异常值误差并提升单步预测精度，与基线离散雅可比学习方法相比，全局平均均方根误差（RMSE）降低了53%以上。对于长时域预测，通过ODE积分恢复的轨迹在稀疏采样（步长 = 8）条件下具有更高的保真度，RMSE中位数降低了14.43%，误差方差降低了24.87%。这些结果表明，学习得到的基于流的雅可比场为刚柔耦合非线性系统中的离线多步轨迹优化提供了一种有效的局部模型。

Authors: Tianyou Liang, Haisen Zeng, Shanjun Chen, YiMing Zhu, Zhongyue Lu, Zirong Luo

LiDARFlow: Real-Time Panel-Based MAV Guidance in Unknown Environments RLRobot

micro aerial vehicles obstacle avoidance LiDAR potential-flow theory onboard guidance

简要说明：LiDARFlow提出了一种基于机载LiDAR的轻量级实时避障制导算法，适用于未知环境中的微型飞行器，该方法源于空气动力学势流理论的panel公式，并通过室内飞行实验验证了其在航点导航和定向引导中的有效性，计算效率高，主要瓶颈是点云处理。

TLDR: LiDARFlow presents a lightweight, real-time obstacle avoidance guidance algorithm for MAVs in unknown environments using onboard LiDAR, based on a panel formulation from aerodynamic potential-flow theory. The method is validated in indoor flight tests for waypoint navigation and directional guidance, showing computational efficiency with pointcloud processing as the main bottleneck.

Abstract: This paper presents a guidance algorithm for micro aerial vehicles operating in unknown, cluttered environments using only onboard sensing. The method is based on a panel formulation originally derived from aerodynamic potential-flow theory and generates smooth, collision-free guidance vectors from locally perceived obstacles. The approach is extended to unknown environments by constructing and updating the obstacle representation online from onboard LiDAR measurements. The resulting obstacle-avoidance field is integrated with a nominal guiding vector field to produce the final control input. The system is experimentally validated in indoor flight tests under two scenarios: waypoint navigation and directional guidance. In both cases, the vehicle successfully completes its task while avoiding all obstacles in real time using only onboard perception. The results demonstrate that the method is computationally lightweight and suitable for onboard implementation, with pointcloud processing identified as the main practical limitation. These results support the feasibility of lightweight onboard guidance in unknown environments.

摘要（中文）：本文提出了一种针对在未知、杂乱环境中仅依赖机载传感运行的微型飞行器的制导算法。该方法基于源自空气动力学势流理论的板元公式，利用局部感知的障碍物生成平滑、无碰撞的制导向量。通过从机载激光雷达测量数据在线构建并更新障碍物表示，该方法被扩展至未知环境。所生成的避障场与名义引导向量场相结合，产生最终的控制输入。该系统在室内飞行试验中进行了实验验证，涵盖两种场景：航点导航和方向引导。在两种情况下，飞行器均成功完成任务，并仅依靠机载感知实时避开所有障碍物。结果表明，该方法计算量小，适合机载实现，其中点云处理被识别为主要实际限制因素。这些结果支持了在未知环境中实现轻量化机载制导的可行性。

Authors: João Machado, Zeynep Bilgin, Matthieu Verdoucq, Murat Bronz

Completion Aware Guidance for World Action Models WorldModel

World Action Models sampling guidance task completion RoboTwin zero-shot simulation

简要说明：本文指出了世界动作模型（WAM）中任务不完整想象的问题，并提出了一种无需训练的采样方法——完成感知引导（CAG），以提高仿真中任务完成的成功率。

TLDR: This paper identifies task-incomplete imagination in World Action Models (WAMs) and proposes Completion Aware Guidance (CAG), a training-free sampling method that improves task completion success in simulation.

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) predict visual futures and robot actions, yet they remain susceptible to task-incomplete imagination, where plausible, action-consistent predictions omit the transition needed for task completion. In this paper, we show that this failure is not inherent to the world model backbone, but emerges when adapted for short-chunk control, which can repeatedly favor plausible local continuations over task-completing transitions. To address this, we introduce Completion Aware Guidance (CAG), a training-free sampling method that guides generation toward task completion. Across representative WAMs, CAG improves success from 64% to 70% on a RoboTwin 2.0 subset and from 69% to 75% in zero-shot simulation, while reducing task-incomplete imagination from 79% to 40%.

摘要（中文）：世界行动模型（WAMs）能够预测视觉未来状态与机器人动作，然而它们仍易出现任务不完整想象的问题，即采用看似合理且与动作一致的预测时，却遗漏了完成任务所必需的过渡环节。在本文中，我们表明这一缺陷并非源于世界模型主干本身，而是在适配短片段控制时产生，这种控制方式会反复偏向于合理的局部延续，而非任务完成的过渡动作。为解决该问题，我们引入了完成感知引导（CAG），这是一种无需训练的采样方法，可将生成过程引导向任务完成方向。在具有代表性的WAMs上，CAG在RoboTwin 2.0子集中将成功率从64%提升至70%，在零样本模拟中从69%提升至75%，同时将任务不完整想象的比例从79%降低至40%。

Authors: Seungyeon Kim, Junhoo Lee, Baekseung Kim, Minkyu Kim, Nojun Kwak

ALFRED: Requirement-driven development of an open-source mobile manipulator for long-term plant monitoring Manipulation

mobile manipulator plant monitoring field robotics mechanical design requirement-driven development

简要说明：本文介绍了ALFRED，一个用于长期植物监测的开源移动机械臂，通过迭代的、基于需求的设计进行开发。它使用基于模型的分析评估设计改进，并报告了一年的成功实地部署。

TLDR: This paper presents ALFRED, an open-source mobile manipulator for long-term plant monitoring, developed through iterative requirement-driven design. It evaluates design improvements using model-based analysis and reports a year of successful field deployment.

Abstract: Tracking seasonal change in crops and forests requires observing the same plants repeatedly. Ground robots can do this at close range, and a manipulator gives their sensors more viewpoints. Yet the robots behind long-term field datasets are rarely released with their design files, and how a robot's own structure limits arm reach and occludes its sensors is seldom compared between builds. We present ALFRED, an open-source mobile manipulator built from commercially available components. It carries a six-degree-of-freedom arm, LiDAR, RGB-D cameras, RTK GNSS and an IMU on an Ackermann-steered base, all mounted on a reconfigurable aluminium strut frame, and runs containerised ROS software. It was developed through four builds against six requirements for repeated outdoor deployment: durability, modularity, repairability, sensing reach, endurance and reproducibility. Model-based analysis of the last three builds shows the usable share of the arm's reachable poses rising from 34.0% to 60.0% and then 66.1%, and ray casting shows that only the final build keeps the frame-mounted LiDAR's horizontal view clear both forwards and backwards. ALFRED completed a year of monthly forest surveys (528 traversals) without missing a scheduled collection. This was despite battery degradation, reconfiguration for another researcher's study, and the parallel development of ALFRED 2.0 for autonomous crop-row operation, with each switch between builds taking about six hours. The deployment also showed that mechanical modularity is only as dependable as the robot description that tracks it.

摘要（中文）：追踪农作物与森林的季节性变化需要对同一植株进行重复观测。地面机器人能够在近距离完成此类观测，而机械臂则为其传感器提供了更多视角。然而，长期野外数据集背后的机器人鲜少随设计文件一同发布，且机器人自身结构对机械臂可达范围的限制及对传感器的遮挡，也很少在不同构建之间进行对比。我们提出了ALFRED——一款基于商用部件构建的开源移动操作机器人。它搭载六自由度机械臂、激光雷达、RGB-D相机、RTK GNSS和IMU，安装于阿克曼转向底盘之上，全部集成于可重构的铝制型材框架中，并运行容器化的ROS软件。该机器人历经四次迭代构建，以满足六项重复野外部署需求：耐久性、模块化、可维修性、传感可达性、续航能力和可复现性。对后三次构建的基于模型的分析显示，机械臂可达姿态中可用比例从34.0%提升至60.0%，进而达到66.1%；光线投射分析则表明，只有最终构建能够确保框架安装的激光雷达在前后两个方向均保持水平视野无遮挡。ALFRED完成了为期一年的月度森林调查（共528次穿越），未遗漏任何一次计划采集。这一成果是在电池性能衰减、为其他研究人员的研究进行重新配置，以及并行开发用于自主作物行作业的ALFRED 2.0的背景下取得的，每次构建切换约需六小时。部署实践还表明，机械模块化的可靠性，取决于对其进行追踪的机器人描述文件的完善程度。

Authors: Ciarán Miceal Johnson, Christopher Quail, Garry Ellard, Alistair McConnell, Steve Tonneau, Fernando Auat Cheein

Is Success All You Need? Investigating the Impact of Input Perturbations on VLA Behaviour in Tabletop Manipulation Tasks VLA

VLA robustness behavioral evaluation input perturbations tabletop manipulation task success rate

简要说明：本文提出了一个与基准无关的VLA模型评估框架，通过分析扰动下成功轨迹的执行方式（而非仅任务成功率TSR）来衡量行为鲁棒性。在LIBERO套件和多种扰动条件下测试发现，扰动会改变成功行为，而TSR无法体现这一点，因此建议在鲁棒性评估中补充行为指标。

TLDR: This paper proposes a benchmark-agnostic evaluation framework for VLA models that measures behavioral robustness under input perturbations by analyzing how successful trajectories are executed, not just task success rate (TSR). Testing across LIBERO suites and perturbation conditions, it shows that perturbations alter successful behavior in ways not captured by TSR alone, advocating for complementary behavioral metrics in robustness evaluation.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have achieved high task success rates on robot manipulation task benchmarks. More recently, there has been an emphasis on evaluating the robustness of VLA models to perturbations. However, this robustness is still predominantly measured through Task Success Rate (TSR). In this work, we propose a benchmark-agnostic evaluation framework to measure the behavioural robustness of models by characterising how successful trajectories are executed under perturbation. We implement this methodology by extending the widely-used LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus benchmarks. Across three state-of-the-art VLA models, four LIBERO task suites and seven perturbation conditions, we evaluate changes in both typical successful behaviour and its variability, including metrics of motion smoothness, efficiency and gripper behaviour. We find that perturbations can alter the behaviour of successful trajectories, a phenomenon which cannot necessarily be inferred from TSR alone. Across LIBERO suites, we identify cases where state-of-the-art VLA models achieve comparable TSR under the same perturbation condition, yet behaviour on successful trajectories diverges substantially. Therefore, to have a more robust assessment of task performance, we argue that suitable measures of robustness should capture not only whether a task is completed, but also how the robot behaves while completing it. When evaluating the robustness of VLA models, TSR may be complemented by behavioural evaluation metrics that characterise the nature and variability of successful task execution by robots.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作任务基准测试中取得了较高的任务成功率。近期，评估VLA模型对扰动的鲁棒性日益受到重视。然而，这种鲁棒性目前仍主要通过任务成功率（TSR）来衡量。本研究提出了一种与基准无关的评估框架，通过刻画成功轨迹在扰动条件下的执行方式来衡量模型的行为鲁棒性。我们通过扩展广泛使用的LIBERO和LIBERO-Plus基准来实现该评估方法。针对三种最先进的VLA模型、四个LIBERO任务套件和七种扰动条件，我们评估了典型成功行为及其变异性的变化，包括运动平滑度、效率和夹爪行为等指标。研究发现，扰动会改变成功轨迹的行为特征，这一现象仅凭TSR可能无法推断出来。在LIBERO各任务套件中，我们发现了在相同扰动条件下，最先进的VLA模型达到了相当的TSR，但成功轨迹上的行为却存在显著差异的情况。因此，为了更全面地评估任务性能，我们认为合适的鲁棒性度量不仅应捕捉任务是否完成，还应反映机器人在完成任务过程中的行为方式。在评估VLA模型的鲁棒性时，TSR可辅以刻画机器人成功任务执行性质及变异性的行为评估指标。

Authors: Sophie Higham, Riccardo Andrea Izzo, Matteo Matteucci, Alessandro Suglia

Continual Learning for 6-DoF Grasp Synthesis via Experience and Demonstrations Manipulation

continual learning 6-DoF grasp synthesis parallel-jaw gripper experience replay demonstration transfer

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于6自由度抓取合成的持续学习框架，通过在学习到的嵌入空间中的记忆进行适应，利用抓取结果和可选的用户演示，在50次真实世界抓取尝试后，对新型物体实现了超过90%的成功率。

TLDR: This paper proposes a continual learning framework for 6-DoF grasp synthesis that adapts through memory in a learned embedding space, using grasp outcomes and optional user demonstrations, achieving over 90% success on novel objects after 50 real-world grasp attempts.

Abstract: Most current grasp synthesis systems are trained offline and remain fixed during deployment. While this works well when deployment conditions resemble the training data, performance can degrade when robots encounter conditions they have not seen before, such as unfamiliar objects. In this work, we present a continual-learning framework for single-view 6-DoF grasp synthesis for a parallel-jaw gripper in cluttered scenes. Rather than finetuning a large parametric model, our method adapts through memory in a learned embedding space: grasp outcomes update future grasp scores, while optional user demonstrations are recalled and transferred to new scenes as additional candidate grasps. We evaluate our method in simulation and in extensive real-world experiments comprising over 1500 grasp trials. We show that our method matches the performance of existing 6-DoF grasping baselines even before adaptation, improves online on unseen objects from categories absent or underrepresented during training, and supports long-horizon continual learning with limited forgetting. In real-world experiments, our method reaches over 90\% success rates on several challenging object categories after only 50 online grasp attempts. Videos and code at https://giuschio.github.io/cl_grasping/.

摘要（中文）：大多数现有的抓取合成系统都是离线训练的，在部署期间固定不变。当初次部署条件与训练数据相似时，这类系统表现良好；但当机器人遇到此前未见过的条件（例如不熟悉的物体）时，性能可能会下降。在本研究中，我们提出了一种用于杂乱场景中平行夹爪的单视图六自由度抓取合成的连续学习框架。我们的方法并非微调大型参数化模型，而是通过在学习的嵌入空间中的记忆进行自适应：抓取结果更新未来的抓取得分，同时可选的用户演示会被回忆并作为额外的候选抓取迁移到新场景中。我们在仿真环境和广泛的真实世界实验中评估了该方法，涉及超过1500次抓取试验。结果表明，即使在自适应之前，我们的方法就与现有六自由度抓取基准方法的性能相当，并能在训练期间缺失或代表性不足的类别中未见物体上在线改进，同时支持带有限遗忘的长时程连续学习。在真实世界实验中，我们的方法在仅50次在线抓取尝试后，就在多个具有挑战性的物体类别上达到了超过90%的成功率。视频和代码见 https://giuschio.github.io/cl_grasping/。
