Authors: Giulio Schiavi, Andrei Cramariuc, Michael Pantic, Roland Siegwart

Interaction-Stiffness-Guided Basis Allocation in Dynamic Movement Primitives for Efficient Skill Transfer Manipulation

Dynamic Movement Primitives basis allocation skill transfer interaction stiffness adaptive representation

简要说明：本文提出阶段关键性引导的动态运动基元（SC-DMPs），根据交互刚度和轨迹一致性自适应分配基函数，以提高机器人技能迁移的精度和泛化能力。

TLDR: This paper introduces Stage-Criticality-Guided Dynamic Movement Primitives (SC-DMPs) that adaptively allocate basis functions in DMPs based on interaction stiffness and trajectory consistency, improving precision-critical robot skill transfer and generalization.

Abstract: Dynamic Movement Primitives (DMPs) provide a compact and stable formulation for trajectory representation and generalization in robot skill learning. However, their predefined basis layout limits the allocation of approximation capacity according to stage-dependent precision requirements. To address this issue, this article proposes Stage-Criticality-Guided Dynamic Movement Primitives (SC-DMPs) with adaptive basis allocation for precision-critical skill learning. Operator-robot interaction stiffness and a trajectory-consistency cue derived from cross-demonstration task-space variability are integrated to construct a stage-criticality index. Guided by this index, basis centers are redistributed in normalized time through inverse cumulative criticality and mapped to the canonical phase domain, while their bandwidths are refined to adjust local approximation support. This enables denser and more flexible representation at high-criticality stages while retaining sparser allocation elsewhere. Experiments on handwriting trajectories and three real-robot tasks show that the inferred criticality is concentrated in geometrically demanding and task-constrained regions. Comparisons with DMPs, ProMPs, ProDMP, GP-MP, and KMP demonstrate improved trajectory reproduction, endpoint generalization, and task-critical accuracy while retaining a compact model and the stable structure of classical DMPs.

摘要（中文）：动态运动原语（DMPs）为机器人技能学习中的轨迹表示与泛化提供了一种紧凑且稳定的框架。然而，其预定义的基函数布局限制了根据阶段相关精度要求分配逼近能力的能力。为解决该问题，本文提出了一种基于阶段关键性引导的自适应基函数分配动态运动原语（SC-DMPs），用于高精度关键技能学习。通过整合操作者-机器人交互刚度以及由跨示教任务空间变异性推导出的轨迹一致性线索，构建了阶段关键性指标。在该指标的引导下，基函数中心通过逆累积关键性在归一化时间上重新分布，并映射至规范相位域，同时对其带宽进行精细化调整以优化局部逼近支持范围。这使得在高关键性阶段能够实现更密集且更灵活的表示，同时在其他区域保持更稀疏的分配。在手写轨迹及三项真实机器人任务上的实验表明，所推断出的关键性集中于几何要求高及任务约束较强的区域。与DMPs、ProMPs、ProDMP、GP-MP及KMP的对比结果表明，所提方法在轨迹复现、端点泛化及任务关键精度方面均有所提升，同时保持了紧凑的模型结构以及经典DMPs的稳定框架。

Authors: Chan Xu, Silu Chen, Dehao Wang, Xiyu Chen, Dexin Jiang, Chi Zhang, Guilin Yang, Chenguang Yang, Zaojun Fang

Supervise What Decides Success: Criterion-Aligned Auxiliary Losses for Latent World-Model Planning WorldModel

latent world models auxiliary loss success-criterion quantities planning robot manipulation

简要说明：本文提出一种辅助损失，用成功判定的物理量作为训练目标回归潜状态，在不改变测试时模型成本和输入的情况下，提升PushT和cube任务的成功率。

TLDR: This paper proposes an auxiliary loss that regresses success-criterion physical quantities from latent states of world models, improving planning success rates on PushT and cube tasks without changing test-time model cost or inputs.

Abstract: Latent world models plan by scoring candidate action sequences with distances in latent space. However, task success is judged by physical quantities, which we call the success-criterion quantities. In all four latent world models we examine, the end-effector position is encoded in the latent state with an error larger than the success criterion allows. Such a latent state cannot separate successful candidates from failing ones. We propose an auxiliary loss that uses success-criterion quantities as training targets, whereas existing latent world models take them only as inputs. During training, a linear head on the encoder and predictor outputs regresses the success-criterion quantities, and the regression error is added to the training loss. The head is discarded after training, so the model, its cost, and its inputs at test time are unchanged. This loss alone improves the success rate on PushT and cube by 3.5% and 3.4% (absolute), respectively, and both improvements are statistically significant. A success criterion thus specifies what a world model must retain in its latent state, and we show that it can serve directly as a training target.

摘要（中文）：潜在世界模型通过评估候选动作序列在潜在空间中的距离来进行规划。然而，任务的成功与否是由物理量判定的，我们称之为成功标准量。在我们考察的所有四种潜在世界模型中，末端执行器位置在潜在状态中的编码误差均大于成功标准所允许的范围。这样的潜在状态无法区分成功的候选与失败的候选。我们提出了一种辅助损失函数，将成功标准量作为训练目标，而现有的潜在世界模型仅将它们作为输入。在训练过程中，编码器和预测器输出上的线性头对成功标准量进行回归，回归误差被加入训练损失中。该线性头在训练后被丢弃，因此模型本身、其代价函数以及测试时的输入均保持不变。仅此损失函数即可将PushT和cube任务的成功率分别提高3.5%和3.4%（绝对值），且两项改进均具有统计显著性。因此，成功标准规定了世界模型必须在潜在状态中保留哪些信息，并且我们表明它可以直接作为训练目标使用。

Authors: Takumi Hara, Kanata Suzuki

EIDA: Execution-Interface Dynamics Adaptation for Real-to-Sim-to-Real Robot Navigation Locomotion

execution-interface dynamics real-to-sim-to-real robot navigation velocity feedback GPU-parallel simulator

简要说明：EIDA调整模拟中的执行接口动力学，以匹配真实机器人的速度指令和反馈，从而提高真实-模拟-真实导航迁移效果，无需详细执行器建模。

TLDR: EIDA adapts execution-interface dynamics in simulation to match real robot velocity commands and feedback, improving real-to-sim-to-real navigation transfer without detailed actuator modeling.

Abstract: Simulation-to-robot transfer can fail when velocity commands produce motion and feedback that differ from those modeled during policy training. We present execution-interface dynamics adaptation (EIDA), which fits these responses from target-platform execution data without reconstructing actuator dynamics. A model of body-frame pose increments updates simulator geometry, while a separate model predicts the velocity feedback observed by the policy; a short history of velocity feedback is included in the policy input. The fitted models are used within a lightweight GPU-parallel simulator. On the full Jackal and Go2 validation sets, the fitted models reduced position and yaw prediction errors relative to the simulator's predefined motion model. Across 100 benchmark navigation environments evaluated in a separate physics-based simulator, EIDA achieved the highest success rate and navigation score among the compared learned policies, both with and without global guidance. Feedback ablations further supported the need to match policy-facing velocity estimates. On a physical Unitree Go2, EIDA reached the goal without collision in all 20 static-scene trials, compared with 4 of 20 for the baseline. These results show that execution-interface adaptation can improve navigation transfer without detailed actuator simulation.

摘要（中文）：仿真到机器人的迁移在速度指令产生的运动与反馈不同于策略训练期间建模的情况时可能会失败。我们提出了执行接口动力学适应（EIDA），该方法通过目标平台执行数据拟合这些响应，而无需重建执行器动力学。一个机体坐标系位姿增量模型用于更新仿真器几何，而另一个独立模型预测策略所观测到的速度反馈；策略输入中包含一段较短的速度反馈历史。拟合后的模型在轻量级GPU并行仿真器中使用。在完整的Jackal和Go2验证集上，拟合模型相较于仿真器预定义的运动模型，降低了位置和偏航角的预测误差。在另一个基于物理的仿真器中评估的100个基准导航环境中，EIDA在有无全局引导两种情况下，均取得了所比较的学习策略中最高的成功率和导航得分。反馈消融实验进一步支持匹配策略端速度估计的必要性。在实体Unitree Go2上，EIDA在全部20次静态场景试验中均无碰撞到达目标，而基线策略仅为20次中的4次。这些结果表明，执行接口适应无需详细的执行器仿真即可提升导航迁移效果。

Authors: Yiwei Qian, Shanze Wang, Qingyuan Hu, Xinming Zhang, Wei Zhang

AFD-CAMLs: Agile Force-Distribution-Aware Planning and Control for Cable-Suspended Aerial Multi-Lifting Systems Manipulation

multi-UAV transport cable-suspended load force distribution admittance filter trajectory planning

简要说明：AFD-CAMLs提出了一种用于缆索悬挂式空中多吊装系统的混合规划与控制框架，在敏捷机动中平衡力的分布，并在真实无人机上验证。

TLDR: AFD-CAMLs proposes a hybrid planning-and-control framework for cable-suspended aerial multi-lifting systems that balances force distribution during agile maneuvers, validated on real UAVs.

Abstract: Multiple UAVs can cooperatively transport heavy payloads while controlling their position and orientation. Trajectory-based methods offer high agility while satisfying system constraints, but can produce uneven force distributions when the tension-to-wrench allocation is redundant or ill-conditioned, particularly under geometric mismatch and low-level tracking errors. We propose a hybrid planning-and-control framework to address this problem. A global planner generates payload trajectories and cable-force references by exploring the allocation null space under a prescribed internal-force setting. These references augment the cost of a centralized local planner, promoting feasible force distributions while generating trajectories for all UAVs. An admittance filter then compares the planned forces with onboard cable-tension estimates and adjusts the kinematic references to improve force tracking in degenerate or near-degenerate configurations. Simulations and experiments involving four to ten UAVs demonstrate more balanced tension distributions during both hovering and demanding agile maneuvers, without compromising agility or payload-tracking performance.

摘要（中文）：摘要：多架无人机可协同运输重型载荷，同时控制其位置和姿态。基于轨迹的方法能够在满足系统约束的同时实现高敏捷性，但当张力到力旋量的分配存在冗余或病态条件时，尤其是在几何失配和低级跟踪误差的情况下，可能会产生不均匀的力分布。我们提出了一种混合规划与控制框架来解决这一问题。全局规划器通过在预设内力设置下探索分配零空间来生成载荷轨迹和缆绳力参考。这些参考增强了集中式局部规划器的代价函数，在生成所有无人机轨迹的同时促进可行的力分布。随后，导纳滤波器将规划力与机载缆绳张力估计进行比较，并调整运动学参考，以改善退化或近退化构型中的力跟踪。涉及四至十架无人机的仿真和实验表明，在悬停和高要求敏捷机动过程中，张力分布更加均衡，且不影响敏捷性或载荷跟踪性能。

Authors: Antreas Kourris, Sihao Sun

PhysicsLENS: Diagnosing Physical Property Blindness in Video Generation Models WorldModel

video world models physics evaluation robot videos physical properties benchmark

简要说明：PhysicsLENS 提出了一个基准和数据集，通过来自机器人视频的匹配场景对来评估视频生成模型表示隐藏物理属性（如重量、粘度、摩擦力）的能力，发现模型往往忽略指定属性但生成看似合理的视频。

TLDR: PhysicsLENS introduces a benchmark and dataset for evaluating video generation models' ability to represent hidden physical properties (e.g., weight, viscosity, friction) using matched scenario pairs from robot videos, finding that models often ignore stated properties while producing plausible-looking videos.

Abstract: Reliable video world models could provide scalable predictive environments for robot learning, planning, and evaluation. However, generated robot videos can violate physical principles and complete tasks through physically implausible behavior, limiting their reliability for robot learning and planning. Current video-generation benchmarks exclude physics that are inherently hidden by visuals (e.g., weight, viscosity, friction). Due to this, video models are evaluated on the fidelity of physics, not the underlying accuracy of physics. We introduce PhysicsLENS, a dataset and benchmark for evaluating plausibility of physical properties grounded in robotics. PhysicsLENS uses matched scenario pairs that hold the same conditioning frame and task, while varying underlying physics in the scene description. Scenarios are curated from public robot video sources and annotated across seven physical domains: collision, gravity, momentum, friction, deformation, fluid, and causality. We evaluate across four video generation models, producing over 400 human-annotated labels. Results show that plausible-looking videos often ignore the stated property (34 of 47), and that stating the property lowers plausibility only slightly and not significantly.

摘要（中文）：可靠的视频世界模型能够为机器人学习、规划与评估提供可扩展的预测环境。然而，生成的机器人视频可能违反物理原理，并通过物理上不切实际的行为来完成任务，这限制了其在机器人学习和规划中的可靠性。当前的视频生成基准排除了视觉上天然隐藏的物理特性（例如重量、黏度、摩擦力）。因此，视频模型评估的是物理表现的真实感，而非物理本身的准确性。我们引入了PhysicsLENS，一个基于机器人技术、用于评估物理属性合理性的数据集和基准。PhysicsLENS采用匹配的场景对，这些场景对在保持相同条件帧和任务的同时，改变场景描述中的底层物理属性。场景选自公开的机器人视频源，并在七个物理领域进行标注：碰撞、重力、动量、摩擦、形变、流体和因果性。我们评估了四种视频生成模型，生成了超过400个人工标注标签。结果表明，表面上合理的视频常常忽略所陈述的物理属性（47例中有34例），且陈述物理属性仅略微降低合理性，且降低幅度不显著。

Authors: Isaiah Milkey, Som Sagar, Aditya Taparia, Xinyuan Liu, Jiqing Wen, Ransalu Senanayake

MASkillBlender: Decentralized Whole-Body Coordination for Multi-Humanoid Loco-Manipulation via Skill Blending HumanoidEmbodied

multi-agent reinforcement learning whole-body control loco-manipulation skill blending humanoid robots

简要说明：MASkillBlender 提出了一种去中心化的多智能体强化学习框架，通过融合可复用的预训练单个人形机器人技能，实现多个人形机器人的协调操作，仅需任务级奖励，并采用基于排列的数据增强策略。

TLDR: MASkillBlender proposes a decentralized multi-agent reinforcement learning framework that blends reusable pre-trained single-humanoid skills to enable coordinated multi-humanoid loco-manipulation, using only task-level rewards and a permutation-based augmentation strategy.

Abstract: Coordinated multi-humanoid loco-manipulation is promising yet challenging due to high-dimensional whole-body control, decentralized decision making, and scalability. While recent reinforcement learning methods have improved single-humanoid whole-body control, extending them to the multi-humanoid setting remains nontrivial and often requires substantial reward engineering or task-specific design. We propose MASkillBlender, a general multi-agent reinforcement learning framework to achieve decentralized multi-humanoid whole-body coordination. By learning a shared decentralized high-level policy over reusable pre-trained single-humanoid skills, MASkillBlender enables coordinated behaviors using only task-level rewards, without requiring task-specific motion references. To improve learning efficiency, we further introduce a permutation-based data augmentation strategy for homogeneous multi-humanoid systems, and theoretically show that the permuted samples preserve the policy-gradient direction of the original samples under the homogeneous Markov game formulation. We evaluate MASkillBlender on multiple multi-humanoid coordination tasks across two humanoid embodiments. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed framework consistently achieves strong task performance and enables coordinated behaviors across different tasks and humanoid embodiments.

摘要（中文）：协调多仿人机器人操作极具前景但也充满挑战，这源于其高维全身控制、分散式决策以及可扩展性问题。尽管近期强化学习方法已提升了单仿人机器人的全身控制能力，但将其扩展至多仿人机器人场景仍非易事，且通常需要大量的奖励工程设计或针对特定任务的定制方案。我们提出了MASkillBlender，一种通用多智能体强化学习框架，旨在实现分散式多仿人机器人全身协调。通过学习一个共享的分散式高层策略，并复用于可预训练的单仿人机器人技能，MASkillBlender仅需任务级奖励即可实现协调行为，无需依赖任务特定的运动参考。为提高学习效率，我们进一步针对同构多仿人机器人系统引入了一种基于置换的数据增强策略，并从理论上证明，在同构马尔可夫博弈框架下，置换样本保持了原始样本的策略梯度方向。我们在多种多仿人机器人协调任务上评估了MASkillBlender，涵盖两种仿人机器人外形。仿真结果表明，所提出的框架在不同任务和仿人机器人外形下均能稳定取得良好的任务表现，并实现协调行为。

Authors: Yifan Hu, Luhang Hong, Mingkang Long, Danning Wang, Chengfeng Jia, Rong Su, Junjie Fu, Guanghui Wen

quARtet Marker: A 3D-Printable Multi-Tag Fiducial for Robust Near-Frontal Pose Estimation Manipulation

fiducial marker pose estimation robot manipulation AprilTags 3D-printable

简要说明：本文提出一种3D打印的多标签基准标记物quARtet，通过倾斜四个AprilTag提高近正面视角下透明或反光实验室器皿的位姿估计精度和可抓取性，并在真实机器人实验中验证了其有效性。

TLDR: The paper introduces quARtet, a 3D-printable fiducial marker with four tilted AprilTags, which significantly improves pose estimation accuracy and graspability for transparent or reflective labware in near-frontal views, demonstrating effectiveness in real robot experiments.

Abstract: Robotic manipulation of labware is difficult when transparent or reflective objects must be identified and localized. Coded planar fiducials are a practical retrofit: easy to print, they leave the marked face flat and graspable. Yet a single planar tag is least reliable in near-frontal views, where perspective cues fade. Non-planar geometries restore those cues but intrude on the flat face that a parallel-jaw gripper must contact. Our idea is to tilt multiple tags within one compact footprint, so that each tag is seen at a non-frontal angle even when the marker faces the camera. We propose the quARtet marker, a 3D-printable fiducial embodying this idea: all detected corners of its four tilted AprilTags enter one Perspective-n-Point solve, and a shared configuration defines the fabricated geometry and the detector model. Because tilting consumes flat area, its three layouts trade pose-estimation consistency against graspability. In robot-referenced, same-setup fixed-camera experiments, all three layouts reduced the mean frontal orientation error from 2.18 degree for a single planar tag to 0.24-0.47 degree and the root-mean-square position error from 1.50 to 0.17-0.20 mm. A robot-mounted-camera pose-hold test confirmed this separation under closed-loop visual feedback. In swing-down trials under identical conditions, the two layouts with flat contact strips retained the object with about 2 mm of in-grasp slip, whereas the layout without flat strips slipped by roughly 100 mm. For the tested conditions, the results support a rule: the layout without flat strips when pose-estimation consistency dominates, a layout with flat strips when the marked face must remain graspable.

摘要（中文）：对透明或反光物体进行识别与定位时，实验室器皿的机器人操控存在较大难度。编码平面基准标记是一种实用的改造方案：易于打印，且能使标记面保持平整并可供抓取。然而，在近乎正面的视角下，单个平面标签的可靠性最低，因为此时透视线索减弱。非平面几何结构能够恢复这些线索，但会侵占平行爪夹爪必须接触的平面表面。我们的思路是在一个紧凑的占用区域内倾斜多个标签，使得即使标记正对相机，每个标签也能以非正面角度被观测到。我们提出了quARtet标记，这是一种 embodying 这一理念的3D打印基准标记：其四个倾斜AprilTag检测到的所有角点均参与一次透视n点求解，且共享配置同时定义了制造几何与检测模型。由于倾斜会消耗平面面积，其三种布局在姿态估计一致性与可抓取性之间进行权衡。在与机器人参考系一致、固定相机的同设置实验中，三种布局均将平均正面朝向误差从单个平面标签的2.18度降至0.24至0.47度，并将位置误差的均方根从1.50毫米降至0.17至0.20毫米。机器人搭载相机的位姿保持测试在闭环视觉反馈下进一步确认了上述分离效果。在相同条件下的下摆试验中，两种带有平面接触条的布局保持了约2毫米的抓取内滑动，而无平面接触条的布局则滑动了约100毫米。在测试条件下，实验结果支持以下规则：当姿态估计一致性占主导时选用无平面接触条的布局；当标记面需保持可抓取性时选用带平面接触条的布局。

Authors: Araki Wakiuchi, Hikaru Sasaki, Takamitsu Matsubara

A Survey on End-to-End Autonomous Driving Training from the Perspectives of Data, Strategy, and Platform AutonomousDriving

end-to-end autonomous driving training ecosystem data-centric pipelines learning paradigms training infrastructure

简要说明：本文对端到端自动驾驶训练进行了全面综述，将最新进展组织为数据-策略-平台分类法，并提出面向鲁棒、可扩展和可信系统的前瞻性愿景。

TLDR: This paper provides a comprehensive survey of end-to-end autonomous driving training, organizing recent advances into a Data-Strategy-Platform taxonomy and offering a forward-looking vision for robust, scalable, and trustworthy systems.

Abstract: Autonomous driving is a cornerstone technology for the future of intelligent transportation, where end-to-end learning has emerged as a transformative paradigm that directly maps multimodal sensory inputs to driving actions through unified differentiable models. While offering advantages, the effectiveness of end-to-end autonomous driving (E2E-AD) is ultimately determined by the quality of its training ecosystem. This paper provides a comprehensive review of training methods and ecosystem for E2E-AD. We introduce a Data-Strategy-Platform taxonomy that conceptualizes training as an interdependent system. The data layer defines what can be learned, the strategy layer governs how learning aligns with driving objectives, and the platform layer supports scalability and continuous evolution. Within this framework, we survey recent advances across data-centric pipelines, learning paradigms, and training infrastructures, and analyze their interplay in shaping model performance, robustness, and deployability. Finally, we reflect on current limitations and articulate a forward-looking vision that emphasizes a shift from data quantity to data value, from isolated optimization to foundation-driven generalization, and from static training to integrated training-testing loops, aiming toward robust, scalable, and trustworthy autonomous driving systems. We maintain a continuously updated repository tracking cutting-edge literature and works at \href{https://github.com/Jiaaqiliu/Awesome-Training-Ecosystem-for-E2E-AD}{Our Project Page}.

摘要（中文）：自动驾驶是未来智能交通的基石技术，其中端到端学习作为一种变革性范式应运而生，通过统一的可微模型直接将多模态感知输入映射为驾驶动作。尽管端到端自动驾驶（E2E-AD）具备诸多优势，其有效性最终取决于训练生态系统的质量。本文对端到端自动驾驶的训练方法与生态系统进行了全面综述。我们提出了一种“数据-策略-平台”分类体系，将训练视为一个相互依存的系统整体。其中，数据层定义了可学习的内容，策略层支配学习如何与驾驶目标对齐，而平台层则为可扩展性与持续演进提供支撑。在该框架下，我们系统梳理了数据驱动流水线、学习范式与训练基础设施方面的最新进展，并分析了它们之间在塑造模型性能、鲁棒性与可部署性方面的相互作用。最后，我们反思了当前存在的局限性，并展望了未来发展方向，强调从数据数量转向数据价值、从孤立优化走向基于基础模型的泛化、从静态训练迈向训练-测试一体化闭环，以构建稳健、可扩展且值得信赖的自动驾驶系统。我们持续维护一个不断更新的资源库，跟踪前沿文献与相关工作，详见我们的项目页面：\href{https://github.com/Jiaaqiliu/Awesome-Training-Ecosystem-for-E2E-AD}{项目主页}。

Authors: Chengkai Xu, Yiming Cui, Jiaqi Liu, Yicheng Guo, Cheng Qin, Geyuan Zhang, Xinwei Dong, Shiyu Fang, Peng Hang, Jian Sun

Lang3DSeg: Annotation-Free Open-Vocabulary 3D Segmentation with Point Transformers AutonomousDriving

open-vocabulary 3D segmentation point transformer LiDAR annotation-free depth ambiguity

简要说明：Lang3DSeg 提出将点Transformer用于无标注开放词汇的室外LiDAR三维分割，通过深度间隙截断和类别优先掩码组合修正投影噪声，在nuScenes和SemanticKITTI上取得最先进实时结果。

TLDR: Lang3DSeg introduces a point transformer backbone for annotation-free open-vocabulary 3D LiDAR segmentation, corrected projection noise via depth-gap truncation and class-priority mask compositing, and achieves state-of-the-art real-time results on nuScenes and SemanticKITTI.

Abstract: Accurate 3D semantic perception is critical for safe autonomous navigation. However, supervised LiDAR segmentation remains tied to closed taxonomies and to the cost of point-wise manual annotation. Open-vocabulary methods avoid that cost by projecting the output of 2D vision-language models onto LiDAR and distilling it into a 3D network. These methods rely almost exclusively on voxel-based sparse convolutions, and point transformers have so far been limited to indoor environments, where 3D data is dense and bounded. We present Lang3DSeg, which establishes a point transformer as the backbone for annotation-free open-vocabulary segmentation of outdoor 3D LiDAR, and is trained from scratch without geometric pre-training. This training paradigm necessitates addressing the inherent noise in 2D-to-3D label projections; specifically, naive projection often suffers from depth ambiguity, where points behind an object are erroneously assigned its semantic label. We therefore composite masks using an explicit class-priority rule and truncate each projected instance at the first gap in its depth distribution, correcting the projection error directly rather than averaging it over registered sequences. Lang3DSeg achieves 52.8% mIoU on nuScenes validation and 41.4% on SemanticKITTI, the highest among published annotation-free methods on both benchmarks. Every 3D semantic segmentation is on a single LiDAR sweep, and inference operates in real-time without running vision-language models.

摘要（中文）：精确的三维语义感知对安全的自主导航至关重要。然而，受监督的激光雷达分割仍受限于封闭的分类体系以及逐点人工标注的成本。开放词汇方法通过将二维视觉-语言模型的输出投影到激光雷达数据上，并将其蒸馏至三维网络中，从而避免了这一成本。这些方法几乎完全依赖基于体素的空间卷积，而点变换器迄今仅限于室内环境，在室内环境中三维数据密集且有界。我们提出了Lang3DSeg，其将点变换器确立为无标注室外三维激光雷达开放词汇分割的主干网络，并在无几何预训练的情况下从零开始训练。这一训练范式要求应对二维到三维标签投影中固有的噪声；具体而言，朴素投影常遭受深度模糊问题，即物体后方的点被错误地赋予该物体的语义标签。因此，我们利用显式的类别优先级规则合成掩码，并在每个投影实例的深度分布首次间隙处进行截断，直接纠正投影误差，而非在配准序列上对其进行平均化处理。Lang3DSeg在nuScenes验证集上达到52.8%的mIoU，在SemanticKITTI上达到41.4%，在两个基准上均为已发表无标注方法中的最高水平。所有三维语义分割均基于单次激光雷达扫描，且推理无需运行视觉-语言模型即可实时运行。

Authors: Cigdem Kokenoz, Amir Salarpour, Alkim Domeke, Christopher Salas, Pedram MohajerAnsari, Long Cheng, Mert D. Pesé, Bing Li

TRACE: Privacy-Preserving Next-Best-View Selection over Distributed 3D Gaussian-Splat Maps Perception3D

Privacy-preserving Next-best-view 3D Gaussian Splatting Distributed mapping Information gain

简要说明：本文提出了TRACE协议，用于多机器人3D高斯溅射建图中的隐私保护下一最佳视角选择，各机器人保持地图私有，仅共享聚合光线量以计算信息增益，以较低通信成本达到接近集中式的性能。

TLDR: This paper introduces TRACE, a protocol for privacy-preserving next-best-view selection in multi-robot 3D Gaussian Splatting mapping, where each robot keeps its map private and only shares aggregated ray quantities to compute information gain, achieving near-centralized performance at reduced communication cost.

Abstract: Share the light, not the map. We study next-best-view selection for a team of robots, each of which builds its own 3D Gaussian Splatting map and keeps it private. A robot picks the view with the largest expected information gain (EIG) about the splats along its own path. This gain depends on the other maps. Their splats occlude its own and shine behind them, so the gain has to be evaluated against the pooled map. No robot has this map. We show that the coupling passes through only two ray quantities, the transmittance in front of a splat and the radiance behind it, and that both are sums over the hits of the ray. Hence, they decompose across the robots, and each robot sums them over depth bins in its own map, along the rays of a candidate view, and sends the sums with their pose derivatives. The robot planning the view turns them into its EIG and gradient on SO(3). Transmittance and Radiance Aggregates, communicated for the EIG, give the protocol its name: TRACE. No robot shares its splats, and the message size does not grow with a map. We prove that the reconstruction is exact unless a depth bin behind a splat mixes hits of two robots, and we bound the error otherwise. Over 100 next-best-view decisions in Habitat-Sim, TRACE picks a heading within 15 degrees of the centralized one in 83.3% of the cases, and its views reach 97.9% of the centralized EIG.

摘要（中文）：分享光线，而非地图。我们研究了一组机器人团队的下一最佳视角选择问题，每个机器人各自构建自己的三维高斯溅射地图并对其保密。机器人沿其自身路径选择对溅射具有最大期望信息增益（EIG）的视角。该增益依赖于其他地图。其他机器人的溅射会遮挡自身溅射并在其后方发光，因此增益必须针对合并后的地图进行评估。没有任何机器人拥有这一合并地图。我们证明，这种耦合仅通过两个光线量传递，即溅射前方的透射率和其后方的辐射度，且两者均为光线命中次数的总和。因此，它们可跨机器人分解，每个机器人沿候选视角的光线在其自身地图的深度区间内求和，并将这些和连同其姿态导数一并发送。规划视角的机器人将其转换为SO(3)上的EIG及梯度。为EIG通信的透射率与辐射度聚合体，赋予该协议以名称：TRACE。没有机器人共享其溅射，且消息大小不随地图增长。我们证明，除非溅射后方的深度区间混合了两个机器人的命中，否则重建是精确的，否则我们界定误差范围。在Habitat-Sim中进行的100次下一最佳视角决策中，TRACE在83.3%的情况下选择的航向与集中式方法相差在15度以内，其视角达到了集中式EIG的97.9%。

Authors: Amirhossein Mollaei Khass, Athanasios Cosse, Qiyu Sun, Nader Motee

Measuring Asset and Scene Reconstruction Effects in Real-to-Sim Robot Evaluation RLRobot

real-to-sim sim-to-real gap scene reconstruction robot evaluation bimanual manipulation

简要说明：本文评估了一种用于机器人评估的真实到仿真重建流程，表明更高保真度的重建环境（建模几何、物理、场景splat）相比默认开源方案能提高仿真与真实的相关性并减小分数误差。

TLDR: This paper evaluates a real-to-sim reconstruction pipeline for robot evaluation, showing that higher-fidelity reconstructed environments (authored geometry, physics, scene splat) improve sim-to-real correlation and reduce score error compared to a default open-source recipe.

Abstract: Simulated evaluation is increasingly used alongside real-world evaluation of robot policies because it is cheaper and easier to repeat; however, its value depends on how closely its outcomes track the real robot's. We test whether our reconstruction pipeline, combining metrically scaled object geometry, authored physical parameters and scene reconstruction, reduces disagreement between simulated and real robot scores relative to a default open-source recipe. We constructed two simulated versions of one bimanual robot cell: an authored reconstruction, using object geometry at estimated metric scale, projected textures, authored physics and our own scene splat; and a baseline, referred to as the default reconstruction, using the open-source recipe of a generative single-image mesh, engine-default physics and a Gaussian-splat scene. Both reconstructions use the same object photographs and scene video. Two policies ran five tasks each, giving ten task-policy pairs, which we call cells; each cell was run twenty times in each reconstruction with all other settings held fixed. Both reconstructions were scored against the same real trials, graded by a third-party evaluator. Pearson correlation between the ten simulated and real cell means is r = 0.90 for the authored reconstruction and 0.51 for the default. Mean score error is 6.97 percentage points for the authored reconstruction and 17.54 for the default, a reduction of 10.56 percentage points. These results show that improving the quality of the environment reconstruction through higher visual fidelity, authored physics and metric scale makes the simulation more faithful to the real world and narrows the sim-to-real gap. We release the harness, the per-trial scores, every reported run's configuration, and the assets and scenes of both reconstructions.

摘要（中文）：模拟评估越来越多地与真实世界中的机器人策略评估结合使用，因为它成本更低且更易于重复；然而，其价值取决于模拟结果在多大程度上与真实机器人的表现相一致。我们测试了我们的重建流程——结合度量尺度的物体几何、作者设定的物理参数以及场景重建——是否能相对于默认的开源方案，减少模拟与真实机器人评分之间的差异。我们构建了一个双臂机器人单元的两个模拟版本：一个是作者重建版本，使用估计度量尺度下的物体几何、投影纹理、作者设定的物理参数以及我们自己的场景高斯溅射；另一个是基线版本，称为默认重建，采用生成式单图像网格的开源方案、引擎默认物理以及高斯溅射场景。两种重建使用相同的物体照片和场景视频。两个策略分别执行了五项任务，构成了十组任务-策略对，我们称之为单元；每个单元在每种重建中运行二十次，所有其他设置保持不变。两种重建均与相同的真实试验进行评分对比，评分由第三方评估者完成。十组模拟与真实单元均值之间的皮尔逊相关系数，在作者重建版本中为r = 0.90，在默认版本中为0.51。平均评分误差在作者重建版本中为6.97个百分点，在默认版本中为17.54个百分点，降低了10.56个百分点。这些结果表明，通过更高的视觉保真度、作者设定的物理参数和度量尺度来提高环境重建质量，能使模拟更贴近真实世界，并缩小模拟到真实的差距。我们发布了测试框架、逐次试验评分、所有报告的运行配置，以及两种重建的资产和场景。

Authors: Sanya Verma, Luca Cilio, Velissarios Christodoulou

Toward Humanoid Robots in Construction: A Teleoperation Feasibility Study HumanoidEmbodied

teleoperation humanoid robot construction tasks XR control pedal-based locomotion

简要说明：本文介绍了一种用于Unitree G1人形机器人的遥操作系统，结合基于XR的上半身控制和踏板式运动，并在两项建筑任务上进行了评估，成功率较高但耗时多于手动操作。

TLDR: This paper presents a teleoperation system for a Unitree G1 humanoid robot using XR-based upper body control and pedal-based locomotion, and evaluates it on two construction tasks, achieving high success but slower times than manual execution.

Abstract: We present a teleoperation system that enables a single operator to perform construction tasks on a Unitree G1 humanoid, combining extended reality (XR) based upper body control with pedal-based locomotion to enable simultaneous manipulation and locomotion. Motivated by persistent labor shortages, hazardous working conditions, and challenges in humanoid autonomy, we investigate teleoperation as a practical near-term approach for reducing physical strain on workers while generating high quality demonstration data. We evaluate the system on two representative construction tasks drawn from O*NET occupational database, and report task success and completion time relative to a manual baseline. The system achieved 100% success on tool transport and 80% success on surface painting, with teleoperation requiring substantially more time compared to manual execution.

摘要（中文）：我们提出了一种遥操作系统，使单一操作员能够控制Unitree G1人形机器人执行建筑施工任务，该系统将基于扩展现实（XR）的上半身控制与基于踏板的移动控制相结合，实现操作与移动的同步进行。鉴于建筑业持续存在的劳动力短缺、危险工作条件以及人形机器人自主性方面的挑战，我们探索将遥操作作为一种近期可行的实用方案，以减轻工人的身体负担，同时生成高质量的演示数据。我们以O*NET职业数据库中的两项代表性施工任务为基准对系统进行了评估，并报告了相对于手动基线标准的任务成功率与完成时间。该系统在工具搬运任务中实现了100%的成功率，在表面喷涂任务中实现了80%的成功率，但遥操作所需时间显著长于手动执行。

Authors: Parastoo Ali Pour, David R. Martin, Chang Min Hur, Bo Zhang, Tommy Zhou, Brandon Thomas Lichter, Shane Stanfield, Pramod Khargonekar, Mohammad Abdullah Al Faruque

Learning Transferable Skills using Goal-Conditioned Bisimulation RLRobot

unsupervised skill discovery bisimulation transferable skills goal-conditioned generalization

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于双模仿真的目标函数用于无监督技能发现，学习动作感知的时间表征，并使技能仅依据影响其执行的状态特征进行条件化，从而在不同布局间实现强泛化。

TLDR: This paper introduces a bisimulation-based objective for unsupervised skill discovery that learns action-aware temporal representations and produces transferable skills conditioned on state features affecting skill execution, enabling strong out-of-distribution generalization to unseen layouts in downstream tasks.

Abstract: Unsupervised skill discovery has emerged as a promising approach for leveraging reward-free datasets to pretrain general-purpose policies. However, current skill discovery methods either require access to expert data or exhibit limited generalization, failing to transfer effectively to previously unseen layouts. A key challenge is to learn representations that capture the temporal structure of the environment while remaining robust to variations across layouts. To address this issue, we present an objective for learning action-aware temporal representations that satisfy the functional equivariance property while preserving the local temporal structure of the environment. Building upon this embedding, we further propose unsupervised skill discovery using bisimulation, which learns transferable skills by conditioning the behavior of skills exclusively on the subset of state features that directly affect their execution. This enforces invariant behavior across different layouts, enabling skills to transfer effectively to other configurations. Finally, through comprehensive empirical evaluations, we show that skills learned in a given environment can be effectively applied to solve downstream tasks in various environment layouts, demonstrating strong out-of-distribution generalization.

摘要（中文）：无监督技能发现已成为利用无奖励数据集预训练通用策略的一种有前景的方法。然而，现有的技能发现方法要么需要访问专家数据，要么表现出有限的泛化能力，无法有效迁移到未见过的布局中。一个关键挑战在于学习能够捕捉环境时间结构、同时对不同布局之间的变化保持鲁棒性的表示。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种学习动作感知时间表示的目标函数，该表示满足函数等变性，同时保留环境的局部时间结构。在此嵌入的基础上，我们进一步提出了基于双模拟的无监督技能发现方法，通过仅将技能行为条件化于直接影响其执行的状�态特征子集，来学习可迁移的技能。这确保了不同布局之间行为的不变性，使技能能够有效迁移到其他配置中。最后，通过全面的实证评估，我们展示了在给定环境中习得的技能能够有效应用于解决各种环境布局中的下游任务，展现出强大的分布外泛化能力。

Authors: Mohammad Amin Abbasfar, Farbod Azimmohseni, Mohammad Hossein Rohban

Does Continual Imitation Learning Remain Grounded? A Language-Perturbed Benchmark for Robotic Task Retention Manipulation

continual imitation learning language grounding semantic robustness LIBERO robotic task retention

简要说明：本文提出了一个基准协议，用于评估 LIBERO 上的持续模仿学习是否保持语言引导行为，表明强大的任务保留并不保证语义鲁棒性。

TLDR: This paper introduces a benchmark protocol to evaluate whether continual imitation learning on LIBERO retains language-grounded behavior, showing that strong task retention does not guarantee semantic robustness.

Abstract: Continual imitation learning evaluates whether a robot can learn new knowledge without forgetting previously learned skills. However, retaining task performance does not ensure the behavior remains grounded in language because policies may rely on scene cues, object associations, or memorized task structure. We introduce a benchmark protocol to study how language-guided behavior changes as robotic policies learn successive tasks. We construct meaning-preserving and meaning-changing instruction variants for the Goal, Spatial, Object, and Long suites of LIBERO. Policy experiments focus on LIBERO-Goal, evaluating Original and Paraphrase instructions after each continual-learning stage. We compare representative continual imitation learning methods under their original assumptions while separating task competence from language sensitivity. The proposed diagnostics complement standard learning and forgetting metrics by measuring semantic robustness, goal adaptation, and language sensitivity. Results show that strong continual-learning performance does not always translate to reliable language grounding, and our diagnostics help determine whether retained skills remain correctly guided by their instructions. Additional materials are available at https://sites.google.com/view/stillgrounded

摘要（中文）：持续模仿学习评估机器人在不遗忘已学技能的前提下学习新知识的能力。然而，保持任务性能并不能确保行为仍然扎根于语言，因为策略可能依赖场景线索、物体关联或记忆中的任务结构。我们引入了一套基准测试协议，以研究当机器人策略学习连续任务时，语言引导行为如何变化。我们针对LIBERO的Goal、Spatial、Object和Long套件构建了保持意义和改变意义的指令变体。策略实验聚焦于LIBERO-Goal，在每一个持续学习阶段后评估原始指令和改写指令。我们在保持其原始假设的条件下比较了具有代表性的持续模仿学习方法，同时将任务能力与语言敏感性分离。所提出的诊断指标通过测量语义鲁棒性、目标适应性和语言敏感性，补充了标准的学习与遗忘度量。结果表明，较强的持续学习性能并不总能转化为可靠的语言基础，而我们的诊断有助于判断保留的技能是否仍能被其指令正确引导。附加材料可在 https://sites.google.com/view/stillgrounded 获取。

Authors: Siddeshwar Raghavan, Ziqin Yuan, Fengqing Zhu, Byung-Cheol Min

ScaffoldM3C: A Multimodal Sequential Monte Carlo Framework for Generative Stable Construction Planning Manipulation

multimodal construction planning sequential Monte Carlo block assembly scaffold tokens real robot demonstration

简要说明：ScaffoldM3C 提出了一种多模态轻量级自回归模型，结合顺序蒙特卡洛方法用于稳定的积木式构建，支持文本/图像/草图条件输入和脚手架标记，在仿真和真实机器人上实现了更快速、更稳定的组装。

TLDR: ScaffoldM3C introduces a multimodal, lightweight autoregressive model with Sequential Monte Carlo for stable block-based construction, supporting text/image/sketch conditioning and scaffold tokens, enabling faster and more stable assembly in simulation and real robots.

Abstract: Autonomously constructing physically realizable 3D structures remains a significant challenge due to combinatorial action spaces, interchangeable components, equifinal assembly sequences, and strict stability requirements during construction. State-of-the-art methods fine-tune large language models for text-based generative construction. However, these approaches do not allow for Multimodal (text, image, sketch) conditioning, overlook the practical role of scaffolding for stabilizing intermediate structures, and suffer from slow inference speeds. Therefore, we formulate construction as a probabilistic next-block generation task with multiple potential assembly actions and multiple potential task conditioning modalities. Concurrently, we explicitly consider the utility of scaffolding by introducing an auxiliary scaffold block token. We present Scaffold Multimodal Monte Carlo (ScaffoldM3C), a multimodal, lightweight, auto-regressive model for stable block-based construction, that proposes a set of next-step candidate blocks. Leveraging these candidates, we utilize Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) to maintain a population of possible assembly sequences, allowing us to consider multiple, potentially different, assembly directions simultaneously. We train our multimodal architecture by extending the StableText2Brick dataset to contain image conditioning prompts and scaffold-stabilized build sequences. ScaffoldM3C is 4x smaller than competing baselines, yielding a 5x to 20x speedup during inference, while achieving comparable construction quality to state-of-the-art methods and higher overall stability. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach through simulations and real-world robot assembly demonstrations.

摘要（中文）：自主构建物理上可实现的三维结构仍是一项重大挑战，原因在于组合动作空间、可互换组件、等效装配序列以及施工过程中的严格稳定性要求。现有最先进的方法通过微调大型语言模型来实现基于文本的生成式构建。然而，这些方法不支持多模态（文本、图像、草图）条件输入，忽视了脚手架在稳定中间结构中的实际作用，且推理速度较慢。因此，我们将构建任务形式化为具有多种潜在装配动作和多种潜在任务条件模态的概率性下一模块生成任务。同时，我们通过引入辅助的脚手架模块标记来明确考虑脚手架的效用。我们提出了Scaffold Multimodal Monte Carlo（ScaffoldM3C），一种用于稳定模块化构建的多模态轻量级自回归模型，该模型提出一组下一步候选模块。利用这些候选模块，我们采用序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）方法维护一组可能的装配序列，从而能够同时考虑多个可能不同方向的装配路径。我们通过扩展StableText2Brick数据集（增加图像条件提示和脚手架稳定的构建序列）来训练我们的多模态架构。ScaffoldM3C的规模比竞争基线模型小4倍，推理速度提升5倍至20倍，同时构建质量与最先进方法相当，整体稳定性更高。我们通过仿真和真实机器人装配演示验证了该方法的效果。

Authors: Gadiel Sznaier Camps, Chengyang He, Guillaume Sartoretti, Eduardo Montijano, Mac Schwager

Iterative Policy Refinement through Semantic Rollout Analysis RLRobot

imitation learning LLM-guided analysis structured policies rollout analysis policy refinement

简要说明：本文提出一种闭环框架，利用LLM对语义化表格回滚数据生成诊断分析代码，迭代优化模仿学习的结构化策略，相比零样本LLM结构性能提升达15%，计算量减少75%。

TLDR: This paper introduces a closed-loop framework that uses LLM-generated diagnostic analysis of semantically meaningful tabular rollout data to iteratively refine structured policies for imitation learning, improving performance by up to 15% over zero-shot LLM structures and reducing compute by 75%.

Abstract: Structured policies improve efficiency, robustness, and interpretability in imitation learning by introducing task-specific inductive bias, but existing structure generation methods rely either on extensive human input or on static domain knowledge encoded in LLMs, which may be inconsistent with the expert demonstrations. We propose a closed-loop framework that iteratively refines structured policies using LLM-guided analysis of policy rollouts. By logging rollouts as semantically meaningful tabular data and prompting the LLM to generate diagnostic analysis code, our method identifies suboptimalities in the policy structure and iteratively corrects them without requiring human instruction. Experiments on car racing and door opening tasks show that our approach improves imitation learning performance by up to 15% over zero-shot LLM-generated structures and requires 75% less compute to achieve the same reinforcement learning performance. These results demonstrate that tabular rollout analysis provides an effective feedback signal to align LLM-generated policy structures with expert demonstrations, and we can utilize it to generate good policy structures automatically.

摘要（中文）：结构化策略通过在模仿学习中引入任务特定的归纳偏置，提升了效率、鲁棒性和可解释性，但现有的结构生成方法要么依赖大量人工输入，要么依赖编码在大语言模型中的静态领域知识，这些知识可能与专家示范不一致。我们提出了一种闭环框架，利用大语言模型对策略回滚的分析来迭代优化结构化策略。通过将回滚记录为语义上有意义的表格数据，并提示大语言模型生成诊断分析代码，我们的方法能够识别策略结构中的次优之处，并在无需人工指导的情况下迭代修正。在赛车和开门任务上的实验表明，与零样本大语言模型生成的结构相比，我们的方法将模仿学习性能提升了最高15%，同时在达到相同强化学习性能时计算量减少了75%。这些结果表明，表格回滚分析提供了一种有效的反馈信号，能够使大语言模型生成的策略结构与专家示范对齐，并且我们可以利用该信号自动生成优质策略结构。

Authors: Feiyu Gavin Zhu, Qi Xu, Zhifei Deng, Zhigang Hua, Luke Simon, Jean Oh, Reid Simmons

Measuring the Stability Assumption Behind Action Chunking Manipulation

action chunking behavioral cloning error propagation closed-loop reactivity stability analysis

简要说明：本文通过注入受控动作误差并测量其在开环和闭环执行下的传播，实证分析了动作分块背后的稳定性假设，发现误差放大普遍存在且重规划很少带来自信的收缩，从而质疑误差累积解释并提出应显式训练闭环反应能力。

TLDR: This paper empirically analyzes the stability assumption behind action chunking by injecting controlled action errors and measuring their propagation under open-loop and closed-loop execution, finding that error amplification is common and replanning rarely yields confident contraction, thereby questioning error-compounding explanations and suggesting explicit training for closed-loop reactivity.

Abstract: Action chunking improves the performance of policies learned by behavioural cloning, and several mechanisms have been proposed to explain why, including temporal consistency, horizon reduction, representation learning, and reduced error compounding. We instead study what happens to an action error once it enters the system. At each state, we inject a small action error and measure how fast it grows or shrinks under two execution regimes: open-loop, where the rest of the chunk is replayed without replanning, and closed-loop, where the policy replans after the perturbation. The fitted rate labels each state as contracting, expanding, or unresolved. Across twelve manipulation tasks from three benchmark suites, we find that confidently stable states are rare, while error amplification is common among states whose propagation rate can be resolved. We further find that the measured propagation rate depends strongly on the fitting horizon: amplification is typically front-loaded, so short windows can overestimate longer-horizon propagation. Finally, we train predictors on these labels and find that a state's open-loop regime can be recovered from camera frames and proprioception alone, while its closed-loop propagation is only partially recoverable because it also depends on how the policy acts after the perturbation. These results suggest that error-compounding arguments alone do not provide a complete account of action chunking: neither passive open-loop dynamics nor policy replanning consistently contracts an injected error, and replanning rarely turns open-loop amplification into confident contraction. This suggests that closed-loop reactivity should be trained explicitly, using perturbation- and tree-coverage-oriented training to expose policies to deviations they must recover from, rather than expected to emerge reliably from standard imitation learning.

摘要（中文）：动作分块提升了通过行为克隆学习到的策略性能，已有多种机制被提出用以解释其原因，包括时间一致性、视界缩减、表示学习以及误差累积的减少。我们转而研究动作误差一旦进入系统后会发生什么。在每个状态下，我们注入一个小的动作误差，并测量在两种执行模式下该误差增长或收缩的速度：开环模式，即分块剩余部分在不重新规划的情况下回放；闭环模式，即策略在扰动后重新规划。拟合得到的速率将每个状态标记为收缩型、扩张型或无法解析型。在来自三个基准套件的十二个操作任务中，我们发现确信稳定的状态很少见，而在传播速率可解析的状态中，误差放大现象普遍存在。我们进一步发现，测得的传播速率强烈依赖于拟合视界：放大效应通常集中在前段，因此短窗口可能高估长视界下的传播情况。最后，我们基于这些标签训练预测器，发现仅凭相机帧和本体感觉即可恢复状态的开环模式，而闭环传播仅能部分恢复，因为它还取决于策略在扰动后的行为。这些结果表明，仅凭误差累积的论点无法完整解释动作分块：无论是被动的开环动态还是策略重新规划，都不能一致地收缩注入的误差，且重新规划很少能将开环放大转变为确信的收缩。这提示闭环反应性应当被显式训练，采用面向扰动和树覆盖的训练方式，使策略暴露于其必须恢复的偏差之中，而非期望其能可靠地从标准模仿学习中自发涌现。

Authors: Aryan Goyal

Evaluating Physical Consistency and Plausibility in Generative Scenario Models for Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

generative scenario models physical consistency vehicle dynamics latent space analysis safety-critical validation

简要说明：本文提出了一种分层评估协议，用于评估自动驾驶生成场景模型的物理一致性和合理性，并在基于VAE及其他生成模型上进行了验证。

TLDR: This paper introduces a layered evaluation protocol to assess the physical consistency and plausibility of generative scenario models for autonomous driving, demonstrating it on VAE-based and other generative models.

Abstract: Generative AI models are increasingly used for scenario generation in autonomous driving. While they can generate realistic-looking scenarios, they often provide limited transparency into learned representations and consistency with real-world vehicle dynamics. This lack of formal assurance limits their use in safety-critical validation and certification workflows. To address this aspect, we introduce a layered evaluation protocol that complements existing methods by assessing models across five layers. The first four layers inspect internal representations and network layers through kinematic alignment, statistical baseline comparison, latent controllability, and activation analysis. The fifth layer evaluates model outputs against vehicle dynamics constraints such as lateral jerk thresholds. We demonstrate the protocol on a Variational Autoencoder (VAE)-based scenario generator. Although standard output-level metrics and visualizations suggest that the generated scenarios are realistic, our protocol provides deeper insight into the extent to which the model's latent space aligns with kinematic features and whether visually plausible trajectories satisfy vehicle-dynamics constraints. We further apply the protocol to additional generative models, demonstrating its applicability beyond the VAE architecture.

摘要（中文）：生成式人工智能模型越来越多地被用于自动驾驶中的场景生成。尽管它们能够生成外观逼真的场景，但在所学表征的透明度以及与真实车辆动力学的一致性方面，往往提供有限的可见性。这种形式化保障的缺失限制了其在安全关键性验证和认证流程中的应用。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种分层评估协议，通过五个层级对模型进行评估，以补充现有方法。前四个层级通过运动学对齐、统计基线比较、潜在可控性和激活分析来检查内部表征及网络层。第五个层级则依据车辆动力学约束（如横向加速度变化率阈值）对模型输出进行评估。我们在一个基于变分自编码器（VAE）的场景生成器上展示了该协议。尽管标准的输出级指标和可视化结果表明生成的场景具有真实性，但我们的协议能够更深入地揭示模型潜在空间与运动学特征的对齐程度，以及视觉上合理的轨迹是否满足车辆动力学约束。我们还将该协议应用于其他生成模型，证明了其适用性不仅限于VAE架构。

Authors: Manasa Mariam Mammen, Zafer Kayatas, Stefan Wagner

Towards Reliable Vision-Language Models for Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

Vision-Language Models autonomous driving visual corruption robustness Visual Evidence Augmentation

简要说明：该论文评估了五种视觉语言模型在自动驾驶中面对不同视觉损坏时的鲁棒性和可靠性，并测试了视觉证据增强（VEA）方法以提升可靠性，发现收益不一致。

TLDR: This paper evaluates the robustness and reliability of five Vision-Language Models for autonomous driving under various visual corruptions, and tests a Visual Evidence Augmentation (VEA) method to improve reliability, finding inconsistent gains.

Abstract: Vision-Language models (VLMs) are increasingly being explored in autonomous driving for tasks such as scene understanding, driving reasoning, decision-making, and end-to-end driving. As their role becomes more prominent, ensuring their robustness and reliability is increasingly important. In real-world conditions, visual inputs may be degraded by sensor imperfections and environmental conditions, potentially affecting both model predictions and their associated confidence. Such degradation is especially concerning in autonomous driving, where safety-critical decisions require models to make accurate predictions and recognize when their predictions may be unreliable. In this work, we evaluate five VLMs (Qwen3.5-9B, Gemma4-E4B, LLaVA-OneVision-7B, DriveFusion/DriveFusionQA-4B, and NVIDIA Alpamayo-1.5-10B) across four driving-related QA datasets with different visual input settings, including single-frame, multi-view, multi-frame, and monocular inputs. Our results show that the effects of visual corruption vary across models, datasets, and input settings, with changes in accuracy and confidence reliability and also differing across conditions. We then apply Visual Evidence Augmentation ($\mathrm{V}{\scriptstyle \mathrm{EA}}$), a recent inference-time method to examine whether it can improve model reliability under degraded visual conditions. We find that $\mathrm{V}{\scriptstyle \mathrm{EA}}$ improves performance for some models and datasets, although the gains are not consistent across all settings.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言模型（VLMs）在自动驾驶领域日益被探索，应用于场景理解、驾驶推理、决策制定及端到端驾驶等任务。随着其作用日益凸显，确保其鲁棒性和可靠性变得愈加重要。在真实世界条件下，视觉输入可能因传感器缺陷和环境因素而退化，从而可能影响模型预测及其相关置信度。这种退化在自动驾驶中尤其令人担忧，因为安全关键的决策要求模型不仅能够做出准确预测，还需识别其预测可能不可靠的情况。在本研究中，我们评估了五种视觉-语言模型（Qwen3.5-9B、Gemma4-E4B、LLaVA-OneVision-7B、DriveFusion/DriveFusionQA-4B 和 NVIDIA Alpamayo-1.5-10B），在四个与驾驶相关的问答数据集上，采用不同的视觉输入设置，包括单帧、多视角、多帧和单目输入。结果表明，视觉损坏的影响因模型、数据集和输入设置的不同而有所差异，准确率和置信度可靠性均发生变化，且在不同条件下表现不一。随后，我们应用了视觉证据增强（$\mathrm{V}{\scriptstyle \mathrm{EA}}$），一种最新的推理时方法，以检验其能否在退化视觉条件下提升模型可靠性。我们发现，$\mathrm{V}{\scriptstyle \mathrm{EA}}$ 对部分模型和数据集提升了性能，但这些增益并非在所有设置下均保持一致性。

Authors: Manasa Mariam Mammen, Priyanka Mary Mammen, Zafer Kayatas, Stefan Wagner

Meta-Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Fast Adaptation of Interactive Policies with Applications to Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

meta-multi-agent reinforcement learning fast adaptation Markov games autonomous driving interactive policies

简要说明：本文提出了一个元多智能体强化学习框架，用于多智能体系统中交互策略的快速适应，并应用于自动驾驶。它定义了元纳什均衡作为解概念，并在驾驶仿真中展示了比预训练MARL基线更快的适应速度。

TLDR: This paper proposes a meta-multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for rapid adaptation of interactive policies in multi-agent systems, specifically applied to autonomous driving. It introduces meta-NE as the solution concept and demonstrates faster adaptation than pretrained MARL baselines in driving simulations.

Abstract: This paper develops a meta-multi-agent reinforcement learning (meta-MARL) framework to enable fast adaptation of interactive policies in a multi-agent system (MAS). Meta-reinforcement learning (meta-RL) enables agents to rapidly adapt to new tasks/environments using a bi-level optimization mechanism. However, existing meta-RL generally focuses on single-agent systems. Extending these frameworks and algorithms to multi-agent systems poses additional challenges, as tasks are characterized by not only the environment but also agents' strategic interactions. To address these challenges, we model multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) problems as Markov games (MGs) and develop a meta-MARL framework for rapid interactive policy adaptation across a distribution of MGs. A new concept, called meta-NE, is defined to describe the desired solution concept in a meta-MARL problem. Sufficient conditions for the equivalence between a meta-NE and a stationary point of the gradient-play-based meta-MARL algorithm are established. Our evaluation on autonomous-driving tasks demonstrates that the proposed meta-MARL method achieves faster adaptation than pretrained MARL baselines, validating the effectiveness of our framework.

摘要（中文）：本文提出了一种元多智能体强化学习（meta-MARL）框架，旨在实现多智能体系统（MAS）中交互策略的快速适应。元强化学习（meta-RL）通过双层优化机制，使智能体能够快速适应新任务或新环境。然而，现有元强化学习通常聚焦于单智能体系统。将这些框架和算法扩展到多智能体系统面临额外挑战，因为任务不仅由环境决定，还受智能体间的策略交互影响。为应对这些挑战，我们将多智能体强化学习（MARL）问题建模为马尔可夫博弈（MGs），并开发了一种元-MARL框架，以实现在博弈分布上的快速交互策略适应。本文定义了新概念——元纳什均衡（meta-NE），用以描述元-MARL问题中的理想解概念。同时，我们建立了元-NE与基于梯度博弈的元-MARL算法驻点之间等价的充分条件。在自动驾驶任务上的评估表明，所提出的元-MARL方法相比预训练的MARL基线实现了更快的适应速度，验证了该框架的有效性。

Authors: Huiwen Yan, Kyriakos G. Vamvoudakis, Mushuang Liu

ROWBench: Do Video Models Render What the Program Specifies? WorldModel

programmable world models benchmark logic-render alignment interaction success rate multi-view

简要说明：PROWBench是一个基准，用于评估可编程世界模型生成的视频是否符合程序指定的事件，通过记录实体状态和带时间戳的事件来验证。

TLDR: PROWBench is a benchmark for evaluating visual fidelity of programmable world models to program-specified events, using logged entity states and timestamped events to verify generated videos.

Abstract: Programmable world models separate executable dynamics from visual generation, offering a promising foundation for next-generation game engines. However, their visual adherence to explicit rules and interactions remains insufficiently evaluated. Existing benchmarks assess visual quality, controllability, and instruction or physical adherence, but rarely test fidelity to fine-grained, program-specified world events. We introduce PROWBench, comprising 170 programmatically constructed episodes and 600 proxy videos covering diverse scenes and interactions. PROWBench logs entity states and timestamped events, including those outside the camera's field of view, as replayable world records, from which it renders synchronized views and proxy representations. This enables generated videos to be checked against the observable consequences of program execution. An extensible framework constructs scenes, controls behaviors, and can render each camera view in different representations, such as coarse 3D, and bounding boxes. The benchmark covers first- and third-person perspectives, with synchronized multi-view observations available for a subset of episodes. Grounded in these records, PROWBench evaluates entity control, long-horizon memory, and, with two VLM-based metrics, Logic-Render Alignment and Interaction Success Rate, adherence to the prescribed timeline and the visual realization of timestamped engine-recorded events.

摘要（中文）：可编程世界模型将可执行的动态与视觉生成分离，为下一代游戏引擎提供了有前景的基础。然而，它们对显式规则和交互的视觉遵循仍未得到充分评估。现有基准评估视觉质量、可控性、指令或物理遵循，但很少测试对细粒度、程序指定的世界事件的忠实度。我们引入了PROWBench，包含170个程序化构建的片段和600个代理视频，覆盖多样化的场景和交互。PROWBench将实体状态和带时间戳的事件（包括摄像机视野之外的事件）记录为可重放的世界记录，并从中渲染同步视图和代理表示。这使得生成的视频能够对照程序执行的可观察后果进行校验。一个可扩展的框架构建场景、控制行为，并能以不同表示渲染每个摄像机视图，如粗粒度3D和边界框。该基准涵盖第一人称和第三人称视角，并为部分片段提供同步多视角观察。基于这些记录，PROWBench评估实体控制、长时程记忆，并通过两种基于VLM的指标——逻辑-渲染对齐和交互成功率，来评估对规定时间线的遵循以及对带时间戳引擎记录事件的视觉实现。

Authors: Zheng-Hui Huang, Guixu Lin, Yu-Ju Tsai, Jian-Kai Zhu, Fengbo Lan, Yu-Lun Liu, Yung-Yu Chuang, Kaipeng Zhang, Zhixiang Wang

World Observer: Joint Actor-Observer Generation for Persistent World Modeling WorldModel

video world models out-of-view evolution panoramic observers actor-observer generation world-space metrics

简要说明：World Observer 提出了一种世界模型，联合生成以智能体为中心的视图和全景观察者，从而实现对视野外区域的持续建模，并在物体重新进入视野时改善其动态状态。

TLDR: World Observer introduces a world model that jointly generates an actor-centric view and panoramic observers, enabling persistent modeling of out-of-view regions and improved dynamics upon re-entry.

Abstract: How can a world model continuously observe regions beyond the actor's current view? Video world models simulate how an environment evolves from an agent's actions, yet remain actor-centric. Once an object leaves the actor's view, they lose direct evidence of its evolution, often failing to preserve its state and dynamics upon re-entry. To address this, we introduce World Observer, which decouples observing from acting by jointly generating a perspective actor for the agent-centric view with one or more panoramic observers that watch selected world regions. This allows objects that leave the actor's view to remain visually evolving in an observer, so their updated states are reflected when they re-enter. We ground the actor and observers by warping from a shared panoramic source for explicit geometric correspondence, and introduce an Observer Sink of high-resolution perspective references to restore fine appearance upon re-entry. Since the observers are decoupled from the actor, they can be placed freely across the scene, extended to multiple locations for broader coverage, and driven by control signals to steer out-of-view evolution. To evaluate out-of-view evolution, we further introduce world-space metrics and a benchmark spanning real and synthetic scenes. World Observer substantially improves out-of-view dynamics while remaining competitive in visual fidelity, camera control, and 3D adherence.

摘要（中文）：摘要：世界模型如何持续观察智能体当前视野之外的区域？视频世界模型通过智能体的动作模拟环境演变，然而其仍以智能体为中心。一旦物体离开智能体的视野，模型便失去对其演变的直接证据，往往无法在该物体重新进入视野时保持其状态与动态。为解决此问题，我们提出“世界观察者”（World Observer），它通过联合生成一个面向智能体视角的透视智能体，以及一个或多个监视选定世界区域的全景观察者，将观察与行动解耦。这使得离开智能体视野的物体能够在观察者中持续进行视觉演变，从而在它们重新进入视野时反映其更新后的状态。我们通过从共享全景源进行扭曲映射来锚定智能体与观察者，以实现显式几何对应，并引入一个由高分辨率透视参考组成的“观察者汇”（Observer Sink），以在重新进入时恢复精细外观。由于观察者与智能体解耦，它们可自由放置于场景各处，扩展至多个位置以实现更广覆盖，并通过控制信号驱动视野外演变的引导。为评估视野外演变，我们进一步引入世界空间度量标准以及涵盖真实与合成场景的基准测试。世界观察者在显著提升视野外动态表现的同时，在视觉保真度、相机控制与三维一致性方面保持竞争力。

Authors: Hyunwook Choi, Dahyun Chung, Hyunsung Kim, Siyoon Jin, Jinhyeok Choi, Junyoung Seo, Seungryong Kim

Weather-Aware Domain Adaptation for Street-View Weather Recognition Perception3D

domain adaptation weather recognition street-view adversarial discriminative autonomous driving

简要说明：本文提出天气感知的对抗判别域适应（WA-ADDA），用于改善自动驾驶中街景图像的天气识别，解决训练数据非街景导致的域偏移问题，并构建了统一的多数据集基准，在多个骨干网络上获得一致提升。

TLDR: This paper introduces Weather-Aware Adversarial Discriminative Domain Adaptation (WA-ADDA) to improve multi-class weather recognition in street-view images for autonomous driving, addressing domain shift from non-street-view training data. It also presents a unified multi-dataset benchmark and evaluation protocol, showing consistent improvements across various backbones.

Abstract: Adverse conditions such as rain, snow, fog, and dust remain challenging for camera-based perception in autonomous driving. We study multi-class weather recognition from street-view images under domain shift, where most available training data come from non-street-view sources that differ markedly from real driving scenes. We propose Weather-Aware Adversarial Discriminative Domain Adaptation (WA-ADDA), which conditions the domain discriminator on predicted weather to promote features that are both domain-invariant and weather-sensitive. We also assemble a multi-dataset benchmark by unifying diverse non-street-view weather collections as sources and real street-view images as targets, and define a standardized evaluation protocol with macro accuracy as the primary metric. Across backbones (ResNet-50, EfficientNet, VGG, DenseNet), WA-ADDA consistently improves street-view performance and yields strong per-class recalls in challenging conditions while preserving clear-weather accuracy. These findings highlight the feasibility of domain-adapted weather recognition and the value of our benchmark for advancing robust, on-board perception.

摘要（中文）：恶劣天气条件（如雨、雪、雾和扬尘）对基于摄像头的自动驾驶感知仍然构成挑战。本文研究了域偏移下街景图像的多类别天气识别问题，其中大部分可用的训练数据来自非街景来源，与真实驾驶场景存在显著差异。我们提出了一种天气感知对抗性判别域适应方法（WA-ADDA），该方法将域判别器基于预测天气进行条件约束，以促进既具有域不变性又对天气敏感的特征学习。我们还构建了一个多数据集基准，将多样化的非街景天气数据集统一作为源域，真实街景图像作为目标域，并定义了以宏平均准确率作为主要指标的标准化评估协议。在多种骨干网络（ResNet-50、EfficientNet、VGG、DenseNet）上，WA-ADDA均持续提升了街景性能，并在具有挑战性的条件下取得了较高的各类别召回率，同时保持晴朗天气下的准确率。这些发现凸显了域适应天气识别的可行性，以及我们的基准在推动稳健机载感知方面的价值。

Authors: Hossein Maghsoumi, George Atia, Yaser P. Fallah

iSEE: Object Permanence Through Self-Supervision WorldModel

self-supervised object permanence slot attention occlusion reasoning world model

简要说明：iSEE 提出了一种完全自监督的框架，通过分离外观和位置流，仅利用重现身作为学习线索，使基于槽位的物体中心表示在遮挡下保持物体永久性，并支持下游世界模型规划。

TLDR: iSEE proposes a fully self-supervised framework that enables object-centric slot representations to maintain object permanence under occlusion by separating appearance and position streams, using reappearance as the only learning cue, and enabling downstream world-model planning.

Abstract: Object permanence, keeping track of an object's identity and position while it is occluded, is central to video representations that track, predict and plan. Trackers that achieve it learn from boxes, track identities and visibility labels. On the other hand, self-supervised object-centric methods discover objects without labels: through slot attention, it represents a video as slots that bind to objects and follow them across frames. However, these slots are lost under occlusion, making the desired permanence impossible. Reasoning permanence is a hard problem because it requires to detect when an object becomes occluded, re-identify when object reappears, and keep the object's hidden position continuous, using reapperance as the only learning cue. To address this, we propose iSEE, a novel framework that offers all three aforementioned requirements, without any labels whatsoever. We built iSEE using the following three proposed components: (i) Object evidence modelling: a slot's attention, compared with its own past, reveals when its object is hidden. (ii) Appearance-position separation: two slot streams let the appearance be held for re-identification while the position keeps changing. (iii) Permanence from reappearance: a walker follows the hidden object's position, trained only on where the object reappears. On LA-CATER static, iSEE returns a reappearing object to its own slot after 86% of occlusions, against 32% for SlotContrast, and localises it while hidden within 4.1 mAP of the label-trained SoTA RAM. The two streams also allow downstream planning, with the position stream as the action of a world model. Project page: https://insait-institute.github.io/iSEE/

摘要（中文）：物体恒存性——即在物体被遮挡时追踪其身份与位置的能力——是视频表征中追踪、预测与规划的核心。实现这一能力的追踪器依赖于边界框、身份标识及可见性标签进行学习。另一方面，自监督的以物体为中心的方法无需标签即可发现物体：通过槽注意力机制，视频被表征为绑定到物体并跨帧跟随它们的槽。然而，这些槽在遮挡情况下会丢失，使得理想的恒存性无法实现。推理恒存性是一个难题，因为它要求检测物体何时被遮挡、在物体重新出现时进行再识别，并保持物体隐藏位置的连续性，且仅以重新出现作为唯一的学习线索。为解决这一问题，我们提出iSEE，一个无需任何标签即可满足上述三项要求的新型框架。我们通过以下三个组成部分构建了iSEE：（i）物体证据建模：槽的注意力与其自身过往状态相比较，可揭示其对应物体何时被隐藏。（ii）外观-位置分离：两个槽流使外观得以保持以用于再识别，同时位置持续更新。（iii）由重新出现推导恒存性：一个行走器跟踪隐藏物体的位置，仅以物体重新出现的位置作为训练信号。在LA-CATER静态数据集上，iSEE在86%的遮挡后将重新出现的物体归还至其原有槽，而SlotContrast仅为32%；在隐藏状态下定位的平均精度（mAP）达到4.1，接近有标签训练的SOTA RAM。双流结构还支持下游规划任务，其中位置流可作为世界模型的动作。项目页面：https://insait-institute.github.io/iSEE/

Authors: Pramish Paudel, Ajad Chhatkuli, Luc Van Gool, Danda Pani Paudel

Towards Subject Consistency over Dynamic Subject Sets in Video Generation AutonomousDriving

video generation subject consistency diffusion post-training autonomous driving testbed evaluation framework

简要说明：本文提出了DynSC-Eval，一个针对动态主体集的视频生成中主体一致性的评估框架，并将其奖励用于自动驾驶测试平台中的扩散模型后训练，降低了不一致性指标。

TLDR: This paper introduces DynSC-Eval, an evaluation framework for subject consistency in long video generation with dynamic subject sets, and applies its rewards to post-train diffusion video models in an autonomous-driving testbed, reducing inconsistency metrics.

Abstract: We argue that as video generation extends to longer durations, subject consistency should be evaluated over \textit{dynamic subject sets}. We therefore introduce \textbf{DynSC-Eval}, an evaluation framework that dynamically tracks eligible subjects throughout their visible lifespans and measures local continuity and global identity preservation using six complementary object-level metrics, with explicit detection of inconsistency events. To validate its effectiveness, we design synthetic experiments that actively inject inconsistency events, demonstrating both the sensitivity of DynSC-Eval and the limitations of existing metrics. Evaluations of diverse models on 5s, 15s, and 60s video generation further reveal substantial subject consistency differences that are obscured by conventional metrics. Beyond evaluation, we construct rewards from DynSC-Eval and apply DiffusionNFT post-training in an autonomous-driving testbed. On 5s generation, our approach reduces the six inconsistency metrics by an average of 13.82\% for Wan-2.1-1.3B and 5.66\% for SANA-2B, with improvements also observed on the I2V model ReSim. Qualitative comparisons further demonstrate the effectiveness of our method. We then extend generation to 10s and 30s through curriculum learning and show that consistency optimization remains effective while largely preserving other capabilities.

摘要（中文）：我们认为，随着视频生成时长延长至更久，主体一致性的评估应在动态主体集合上进行。为此，我们引入了 **DynSC-Eval** 评估框架，该框架可在其可见生命周期内动态追踪合格主体，并使用六项互补的对象级指标来衡量局部连续性和全局身份保持，同时显式检测不一致事件的发生。为验证其有效性，我们设计了主动注入不一致事件的合成实验，既展示了DynSC-Eval的敏感性，也揭示了现有指标的局限性。对多种模型在5秒、15秒和60秒视频生成上的评估进一步表明，存在以往传统指标所掩盖的显著主体一致性差异。在评估之外，我们从DynSC-Eval构建奖励，并将其应用于自动驾驶测试平台中的DiffusionNFT后训练。在5秒生成任务中，我们的方法使Wan-2.1-1.3B和SANA-2B六项不一致性指标平均分别降低了13.82%和5.66%，在I2V模型ReSim上也观察到了改进。定性比较进一步验证了我们方法的有效性。随后，我们通过课程学习将生成时长扩展至10秒和30秒，并表明一致性优化依然有效，同时在很大程度上保留了其他能力。

Authors: Tongcheng Zhang, Jun Zhu, Jianfei Chen

SemanTok: Predictable Semantic Tokens for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation WorldModel

video tokenizer autoregressive video generation world models semantic alignment flexible-length tokens

简要说明：SemanTok 提出了一种视频分词器，利用冻结的 DINO 特征和轻量重建头生成语义对齐、长度灵活的 token，从而提升自回归视频生成和世界模型的效率与质量。

TLDR: SemanTok introduces a video tokenizer that incorporates frozen DINO features and lightweight reconstruction heads to produce semantically aligned, flexible-length tokens, enabling more efficient and higher-quality autoregressive video generation and world models.

Abstract: Recent video-based world models pair the scalability of autoregressive (AR) prediction with the visual quality of diffusion models. The choice of scene tokenizer is paramount for the optimal performance of each of these, both in terms of fidelity and semantics. Flexible-length, coarse-to-fine tokenizers yield exactly that: the first coarse tokens carry the clip's global semantics while later tokens further specify details. Existing flexible tokenizers only apply a representation-alignment (REPA) loss on early decoder hidden states, a target the decoder can partly meet from its noised input instead. We introduce SemanTok, a flexible video tokenizer that feeds frozen DINO features into its encoder and adds lightweight heads that reconstruct them from each retained token prefix alone. SemanTok achieves high semantic alignment and video fidelity at every AR model size: a 201M SemanTok AR model matches or beats a VideoFlexTok AR model $3.4\times$ its size, and larger SemanTok AR models further improve fidelity. It keeps semantic alignment on out-of-distribution classes and gives the decoder higher semantic alignment at every noise level, including pure noise. It performs well in both reconstruction and generation, and its short token prefixes are cheaper to predict and give better generation fidelity, with pixel detail deferred to later tokens.

摘要（中文）：近期基于视频的世界模型将自回归（AR）预测的可扩展性与扩散模型的视觉质量相结合。场景分词器的选择对于这两者在保真度和语义方面的最优性能至关重要。灵活长度、从粗到细的分词器恰好实现了这一点：前面的粗粒度分词携带视频片段的全局语义，而后面的分词则进一步细化细节。现有的灵活分词器仅对早期解码器隐藏状态施加表示对齐（REPA）损失，而解码器可以部分地从其加噪输入中满足这一目标。我们提出了SemanTok，一种灵活的視頻分词器，将冻结的DINO特征馈入其编码器，并添加轻量级头，仅从每个保留的分词前缀重建这些特征。SemanTok在所有AR模型规模下均实现了高语义对齐和视频保真度：一个201M的SemanTok AR模型可媲美或超越其3.4倍规模的VideoFlexTok AR模型，更大的SemanTok AR模型则进一步提升保真度。它在分布外类别上保持了语义对齐，并在每个噪声级别（包括纯噪声）下为解码器提供更高的语义对齐。它在重建和生成两方面均表现良好，其短分词前缀预测成本更低，且生成保真度更高，像素细节则延后至后续分词。

Authors: Mikhail Dereviannykh, Vikram Voleti, Simon Donne, Mallikarjun Byrasandra Ramalinga Reddy, Shimon Vainer, Mark Boss

Variational Streaming Flow: Probabilistic Forecasting in Physical Time WorldModel

probabilistic forecasting streaming flow world models JEPA robot navigation

简要说明：本文提出变分流（VSF），通过学习动力学潜分布扩展流匹配，实现高效的概率预测，并可无缝集成到JEPA世界模型中，提升机器人导航、运动规划和操作的任务成功率。

TLDR: This paper introduces Variational Streaming Flow (VSF), a probabilistic forecasting method that extends streaming flow by learning a latent distribution over dynamics, enabling efficient and accurate probabilistic forecasts for dynamical systems, and demonstrates its utility as a plug-and-play predictor in JEPA-based world models for robot navigation, motion planning, and manipulation.

Abstract: Probabilistic forecasting is important for predicting complex dynamical systems because intrinsic randomness and incomplete observations can cause the same observed state to evolve into multiple plausible futures. While flow matching is a flexible approach for probabilistic forecasting, it is computationally expensive. Streaming flow (SF) reformulates this approach to model temporal evolution efficiently by learning a continuous velocity field directly in physical time. However, SF learns a deterministic velocity field. Thus, it provides only a single future trajectory for a given fixed initial state and observation history. To overcome this limitation, we introduce Variational Streaming Flow (VSF). Our approach learns a latent distribution that is conditioned on the dynamics of interest. In turn, this enables probabilistic forecasting. Importantly, we retain the computational efficiency of SF by generating in physical time. Across deterministic and stochastic dynamical systems, VSF demonstrates superior predictive accuracy and distributional fidelity. We demonstrate the advantage for both long-horizon rollouts exceeding 1,000 steps, and settings with bifurcating dynamics. Moreover, VSF can be integrated into existing Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA)-based world models as a plug-and-play predictor to improve temporal dynamics and goal-directed success rate in navigation, motion planning, and manipulation.

摘要（中文）：概率预报对于预测复杂动力系统至关重要，因为固有随机性和不完整的观测可能导致相同的观测状态演化为多种可能的未来。尽管流匹配是一种灵活的概率预报方法，但其计算成本较高。流式流（SF）通过直接在物理时间中学习连续速度场，对该方法进行重构，从而高效地建模时间演化过程。然而，SF学习的是确定性速度场，因此对于给定的固定初始状态和观测历史，仅能提供单一未来轨迹。为克服这一局限，我们引入了变分流式流（VSF）。该方法学习一个以目标动态为条件的潜在分布，从而实现概率预报。重要的是，我们通过在物理时间内生成轨迹，保留了SF的计算效率。在确定性和随机动力系统中，VSF均展现出优越的预测精度和分布保真度。我们证明了其在超过1，000步的长时程展开以及具有分叉动力学的场景中的优势。此外，VSF可作为即插即用的预测器集成到现有基于联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）的世界模型中，以提升导航、运动规划和操作任务中的时间动态建模能力和目标导向成功率。

Authors: Hans Hao-Hsun Hsu, Minseon Gwak, Soon Hoe Lim, Pan Li, N. Benjamin Erichson

SonarVoxNet: Diver Detection in 3D Bounding Box using 3D Sonar Perception3D

3D sonar diver detection oriented bounding box 6D rotation autonomous underwater vehicle

简要说明：本文提出了SonarVoxNet，首个基于3D声呐的潜水员检测器，预测带有连续6D旋转表示的9自由度有向边界框，并发布了首个带完整姿态标注的Diver3D数据集。结果表明，完整的SO(3)旋转表示是准确检测潜水员的关键，为AUV与潜水员交互奠定基础。

TLDR: This paper introduces SonarVoxNet, the first 3D sonar-based diver detector predicting full 9-DoF oriented bounding boxes with continuous 6D rotation, along with the first public 3D sonar dataset (Diver3D) with full orientation labels. It demonstrates that full-SO(3) rotation representation is key to accurate diver detection, enabling diver-robot interaction for AUVs.

Abstract: Autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) assisting human divers must continuously track not only the diver's 3D position but also their full-body orientation. However, vision-based perception is unreliable underwater, and forward-looking sonar -- despite being widely used -- discards the elevation information needed for orientation estimation, posing a fundamental limitation. Recently commercialized 3D sonar preserves elevation but produces sparse, noisy returns, and existing detectors are built for dense LiDAR data and for targets that remain upright and rotate only about the yaw axis (e.g., vehicles, pedestrians), making them unable to represent a freely pitching and rolling diver. To address this gap, we present two contributions. First, SonarVoxNet adapts a voxel-based encoder and an anchor-free center-based detection head to 3D sonar data, replacing the conventional yaw-only rotation representation with a continuous 6D rotation parameterization to predict full 9-DoF oriented bounding boxes -- to our knowledge, the first 3D sonar diver detector to do so. Second, Diver3D is the first public 3D sonar dataset with full 3D orientation labels for divers in diverse, non-upright poses, collected at a natural cave-diving site. Through controlled ablations over the backbone and detection head, we show that the dominant factor behind accurate 3D sonar-based diver detection is the transition from yaw-only rotation to full-SO(3) rotation. This transition substantially improves detection accuracy and reduces orientation error. These results demonstrate that full-body diver orientation is recoverable from 3D sonar alone, laying the groundwork for future work on diver pose estimation and diver-robot interaction.

摘要（中文）：自主水下航行器（AUV）在协助人类潜水员时，不仅需要持续追踪潜水员的三维位置，还需追踪其全身姿态。然而，基于视觉的感知在水下环境中并不可靠，而前视声呐——尽管被广泛使用——却丢弃了姿态估计所需的仰角信息，这构成了根本性的限制。近年来商业化的三维声呐保留了仰角信息，但产生的数据稀疏且噪声较大，且现有检测器是为密集激光雷达数据以及保持直立、仅绕偏航轴旋转的目标（如车辆、行人）设计的，因此无法表示自由俯仰和横滚的潜水员。为弥补这一空白，我们提出两项贡献。第一，SonarVoxNet将基于体素的编码器与无锚框的基于中心的检测头适配至三维声呐数据，用连续的六维旋转参数化替代传统的仅偏航旋转表示，以预测完整的九自由度有向包围盒——据我们所知，这是首个实现该功能的三维声呐潜水员检测器。第二，Diver3D是首个公开的、包含潜水员多样化非直立姿态下完整三维姿态标签的三维声呐数据集，采集自天然洞穴潜水地点。通过对骨干网络和检测头的受控消融实验，我们表明，实现基于三维声呐的潜水员精确检测的主导因素是从仅偏航旋转向完整SO(3)旋转的转变。这一转变显著提升了检测精度并降低了姿态误差。这些结果表明，仅凭三维声呐即可恢复潜水员的全身姿态，为未来潜水员姿态估计及潜水员-机器人交互研究奠定了基础。

Authors: Eugene Park, Jiwon Lee, Seyoung Kan, Trung Dong, Xiaomin Lin, Jane Shin

OpenSpace Lab Solution to the IROS 2026 Indoor Exploration Competition Other

exploration map completion multi-robot coordination coverage budget constraints

简要说明：本文介绍了在IROS 2026比赛中获奖的单机器人和多机器人探索策略，利用地图补全预测和效用驱动的目标选择来在时间和预算约束下最大化覆盖率。

TLDR: This paper presents an exploration strategy for single- and multi-robot systems that won awards at the IROS 2026 competition, using map completion predictions and utility-driven target selection to maximize coverage under time and budget constraints.

Abstract: This report presents the \textbf{OpenSpace Lab}'s solution to the Competition on Intelligent Information Gathering for Single and Multi-Robot Systems Workshops, organized as part of the IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS) 2026. Our team reached 1st place in the Single-Robot Public Track and 3rd place in both the Single- and Multi-Robot Private Tracks. The single-robot framework utilizes pre-trained map completion predictions for global planning to prioritize unexplored areas. To reconcile map coverage with limited operation time, we introduce a remaining-time-based exploration strategy that integrates homing constraints into the decision-making process. For multi-robot exploration, we utilize a utility-driven target selection strategy that balances observation gains, movement costs, and budget constraints, leveraging shared map and intent data to eliminate redundant search and maximize coordination efficiency. Our solution reached a 61.04\% coverage rate in the Single-Robot Public Track, while reaching 39.53\% and 39.91\% coverage in the Single- and Multi-Robot Private Tracks, respectively. An extended full-length paper based on this report is currently being prepared for submission, and the source code will be released upon acceptance of the full manuscript at https://github.com/OpenSpace-Lab/Indoor-Exploration-IROS2026.

摘要（中文）：本报告介绍了**OpenSpace Lab**针对IEEE/RSJ国际智能机器人与系统会议（IROS）2026期间举办的单机器人与多机器人系统智能信息采集竞赛所提出的解决方案。我们的团队在单机器人公开赛道上获得第一名，并在单机器人和多机器人私有赛道上均获得第三名。单机器人框架利用预训练的地图补全预测进行全局规划，优先探索未覆盖区域。为协调地图覆盖率与有限运行时间之间的矛盾，我们提出了一种基于剩余时间的探索策略，将返航约束纳入决策过程。对于多机器人探索，我们采用基于效用驱动的目标选择策略，该策略综合权衡观测收益、移动成本与预算约束，并利用共享地图与意图数据消除冗余搜索，最大化协同效率。我们的解决方案在单机器人公开赛道上达到61.04%的覆盖率，在单机器人和多机器人私有赛道上分别达到39.53%和39.91%的覆盖率。基于本报告的扩展全文正在准备投稿中，稿件一经录用，源代码将在https://github.com/OpenSpace-Lab/Indoor-Exploration-IROS2026 公开发布。

Authors: Yuxuan Zhang, Dong Li, Zezhou Sun, Yuxuan Xu, Siyu Teng, Yuchen Li, Jianjian Yang, Long Chen

Cross-entropy optimization with prioritized constraints Other

cross-entropy method constraint priorities elite selection world-model 2D navigation

简要说明：TierCEM 在精英选择中强制执行严格的约束优先级，并在 proprioceptive 和学习的世界模型设置中的 2D 导航和推动任务上进行了评估。

TLDR: TierCEM enhances the cross-entropy method to enforce strict constraint priorities during elite selection, evaluated on 2D navigation and pushing tasks in proprioceptive and learned world-model settings.

Abstract: When constraints conflict, an optimizer must determine which requirements to preserve and which to relax. On the one hand, a priority ordering specifies which requirements take precedence. On the other hand, penalty-based formulations encode their relative importance through numerical weights. Depending on these weights, a solution can improve its weighted score while violating intended priorities. We introduce TierCEM, a variant of the cross-entropy method that incorporates strict constraint priorities directly into elite selection without requiring per-constraint importance weights. TierCEM works by sequentially filtering sampled candidates, from highest- to lowest-priority constraint. If and when a constraint eliminates all remaining candidates, TierCEM returns to the last nonempty set and selects elites with the smallest violations of that blocking constraint, recursively preserving satisfaction of all higher-priority constraints. We evaluate TierCEM on 2D navigation and contact-rich pushing tasks in proprioceptive and learned world-model settings. Experiments show that reversing the constraint ordering changes which constraints are violated under conflict. Prioritizing progress toward the task objective also enables TierCEM to relax lower-priority constraints when they would otherwise prevent further progress.

摘要（中文）：当约束条件相互冲突时，优化器必须决定保留哪些要求、放宽哪些要求。一方面，优先级排序规定了哪些要求优先满足。另一方面，基于惩罚的公式通过数值权重来表达各要求的相对重要性。根据这些权重的设置，解可能会在违背预定优先级的情况下改善其加权得分。我们提出了TierCEM，一种交叉熵方法的变体，将严格的约束优先级直接纳入精英选择过程，而无需逐约束的重要性权重。TierCEM通过从最高优先级约束到最低优先级约束逐级筛选采样候选解来实现。如果某个约束条件将所有剩余候选解全部淘汰，TierCEM将回溯到最后一个非空集合，并选择对该阻塞约束违反最小的精英解，从而递归地保证所有更高优先级约束的满足。我们在本体感知和 learned 世界模型设置下的二维导航及接触丰富的推物任务中评估了TierCEM。实验表明，颠倒约束顺序会改变冲突情况下被违反的约束。优先考虑任务目标的进展，也使TierCEM能够在低优先级约束阻碍进一步进展时放宽这些约束。

Extreme Length Generalization in a Compact Recurrent Architecture for One-Shot Exploration Other

简要说明：FRANK是一种紧凑的循环架构，在算法任务上实现了极端长度泛化，并在物理地面车辆上演示了单次航点导航，弥合了序列学习与具身控制之间的鸿沟。

TLDR: FRANK is a compact recurrent architecture achieving extreme length generalization on algorithmic tasks and demonstrates one-shot waypoint navigation on a physical ground vehicle, bridging sequence learning and embodied control.

Abstract: Autonomous robots on one-shot missions run over horizons far longer than the trajectories seen during training, under a fixed onboard compute budget. We present FRANK, a 507K-parameter recurrent architecture that combines tau-gated recurrent modules, content-addressable memory, and a feedforward reflex pathway. We evaluate it against recurrent, state-space, and reduced modular baselines at matched parameter count on four algorithmic sequence tasks, trained at length 5-20 and evaluated out to two million tokens. At 100,000x the maximum training length, 6 of 10 FRANK seeds retain exactly 100.0% accuracy, while none of the 50 baseline configurations does, five architectures at ten seeds each with none left incomplete (Fisher exact, two-sided p = 4.2E-6. Targeted lesions across the four tasks yield four distinct component-reliance profiles, consistent with task-dependent allocation across the recurrent, memory, and reflex pathways. Separately, a FRANK policy trained in simulation drives a physical ground vehicle to commanded waypoints through obstacles without teleoperation.

摘要（中文）：自主机器人在单次任务中运行的时间跨度远超训练期间所见轨迹，且受限于固定的机载计算预算。我们提出了FRANK，一种包含507K参数的循环架构，结合了tau门控循环模块、内容可寻址存储器以及前馈反射通路。我们在四个算法序列任务上，以匹配的参数数量，将其与循环、状态空间及精简模块化基线进行对比评估，训练长度为5至20，评估延伸至两百万个令牌。在最大训练长度扩展至100,000倍的情况下，10个FRANK种子中有6个保持精确的100.0%准确率，而50个基线配置中无一达到此水平，五种架构各采用十个种子，均未出现不完整情况（Fisher精确检验，双尾p = 4.2E-6）。针对四个任务的定向消融实验揭示了四种不同的组件依赖特征，与循环、记忆及反射通路间的任务依赖分配相一致。此外，在仿真环境中训练的FRANK策略，无需远程操作即可驱动实体地面车辆绕过障碍到达指定路径点。
