Authors: Alan Estrada Flores, Nelson Rosa

On the Divergence of Accuracy and Mechanism Consistency in Time Series World Models WorldModel

time series world models mechanism consistency directional supervision action-conditioned forecasting plan fusion

简要说明：本文形式化了时间序列世界模型，引入机制一致性指标来检验预测器对动作变化的响应是否与真实系统一致，并发现提升准确性的设计选择可能损害机制一致性，提出方向监督损失以改善一致性。

TLDR: This paper formalizes time series world models, introduces a mechanism consistency metric to test whether forecasters respond to action changes as real systems do, and finds that design choices improving accuracy can reduce mechanism consistency, proposing a directional supervision loss to improve it.

Abstract: A time series world model (TSWM) predicts a controlled system's state from its observed history and planned actions and exogenous inputs. Current approaches build forecasters with actions as covariates, trained and evaluated on prediction error under the executed plan. Yet world models compare unexecuted plans, but their responses to changed plans remain untested. We ask which design choices matter and whether accurate forecasters respond to changed plans as real systems do. We address both with a formalization and benchmark. The formalization separates state, actions and exogenous inputs, distinguishes continuous, mode and event actions, and introduces mechanism consistency, a metric built on declared action-state relations with known directions, such as a vasopressor raising blood pressure: it checks whether shifting an action moves the forecast in the declared direction. The benchmark consolidates eight public datasets with real actions from engineered infrastructure and clinical care, varying prediction space, plan fusion and plan encoding across seven backbones and five seeds. First, a frozen latent prediction space lowers MAE by 9.9% over observation space and gated output fusion lowers it by 12.7% over input concatenation on average, with both improving all eight datasets; temporal plan encoding changes average MAE by at most 2.2%. Second, prediction error and mechanism consistency diverge: the lowest-error configuration is at or below chance in consistency on four of five datasets with declared mechanisms, and no design choice avoids this. Finally, directional supervision, a loss penalizing the wrong-signed part of the response to a shifted action, significantly raises consistency on penalized mechanisms with no change in MAE. Together they give TSWMs a recipe: a frozen latent space and output-side fusion for accuracy, and a training objective for mechanism consistency.

摘要（中文）：时间序列世界模型（TSWM）从观测到的历史数据、计划动作及外部输入中预测受控系统的状态。现有方法将动作作为协变量构建预测器，并在已执行计划下以预测误差进行训练和评估。然而，世界模型需要对未执行计划进行比较，但其对改变后的计划所作出的响应尚未得到验证。我们提出两个问题：哪些设计选择至关重要？准确的预测器是否能够像真实系统一样对改变的计划作出响应？我们通过形式化定义和基准测试来回答这两个问题。该形式化定义将状态、动作和外部输入分离，区分连续动作、模式动作和事件动作，并引入机制一致性（mechanism consistency）这一指标，其建立在已声明的动作-状态关系之上且方向已知，例如升压药可升高血压：该指标检验改变某个动作是否使预测向声明方向移动。该基准测试整合了来自工程基础设施和临床护理的八个公共数据集，包含真实动作，并在七个骨干网络和五个随机种子上变化预测空间、计划融合方式和计划编码方式。首先，冻结的潜在预测空间相较于观测空间平均降低MAE 9.9%，门控输出融合相较于输入拼接平均降低MAE 12.7%，且两者在所有八个数据集上均带来改进；时间计划编码对平均MAE的改变最多不超过2.2%。其次，预测误差与机制一致性出现分歧：在具有声明机制的五组数据集中，误差最低的配置在四组上的一致性达到或低于随机水平，且没有任何设计选择能够避免这一问题。最后，方向性监督——即对动作改变后响应中符号错误部分施加惩罚的损失函数——在被惩罚的机制上显著提升一致性，且MAE不变。综合而言，这些发现为TSWM提供了设计准则：采用冻结潜在空间和输出侧融合以提高精度，并采用训练目标以保证机制一致性。

Authors: Haochen Zhang, Jiaheng Guo, Zhen Xu, Zachary Plotkin, Nicholas Konz, Zhen Tan, Tianlong Chen

Token Communication-Assisted Collaborative Embodied Artificial Intelligence: Concepts, Framework, and Opportunities Other

token communication collaborative embodied intelligence generative foundation models task-adaptive communication protocol collaborative object transport

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于协作具身人工智能的令牌通信（TokCom）框架，令牌作为生成式基础模型的紧凑语义载体和推理单元，在协作物体搬运案例中降低了通信开销并保持了任务效率。

TLDR: This paper introduces a token communication (TokCom) framework for collaborative embodied AI, where tokens serve as compact semantic carriers and inference units for generative foundation models, reducing communication overhead while preserving task efficiency in a simulated collaborative object transport case study.

Abstract: Collaborative embodied artificial intelligence (CEAI) enables multiple physical agents to perceive, reason, and act cooperatively in dynamic environments. Effective communication is essential for CEAI, yet CEAI agents must exchange not only large multimodal observations but also task-relevant insights, intents, and interactive information over long horizons. This article investigates token communication (TokCom) as a native intelligence interface for CEAI, in which tokens serve jointly as compact semantic carriers for communication and fundamental inference units for generative foundation models (GFMs). We first discuss how TokCom supports insight sharing, intent alignment, and interactive control among embodied agents. We then propose a TokCom-assisted CEAI framework driven by a task-adaptive communication protocol. Comprising a compact codebook, syntax rules, and contextual examples, this protocol guides GFM-based transceivers to distill messages into compact tokens and reconstruct them after wireless transmission. A case study on collaborative object transport demonstrates that the proposed TokCom framework substantially reduces the source payload bit consumption while preserving task efficiency and showing robustness under noisy channels. Finally, we outline future research directions.

摘要（中文）：协作式具身人工智能（CEAI）使多个物理智能体能够在动态环境中协同感知、推理与行动。有效通信对于CEAI至关重要，然而CEAI智能体不仅需要交换大规模多模态观测数据，还需在长时间跨度内传递与任务相关的洞察、意图及交互信息。本文探讨将令牌通信（TokCom）作为CEAI的原生智能接口，其中令牌同时作为紧凑的语义载体用于通信，并作为生成式基础模型（GFMs）的基本推理单元。我们首先讨论TokCom如何支持具身智能体之间的洞察共享、意图对齐和交互控制。随后，我们提出一种由任务自适应通信协议驱动的TokCom辅助CEAI框架。该协议由紧凑码本、语法规则和上下文示例组成，引导基于GFM的收发器将消息提炼为紧凑令牌，并在无线传输后将其重建。一项关于协作物体搬运的案例研究表明，所提出的TokCom框架在保持任务效率的同时，显著减少了信源有效载荷比特消耗，并在噪声信道下展现出鲁棒性。最后，我们展望了未来研究方向。

Authors: Peng Yi, Ying-Chang Liang

iADD: Improving Alignment and Diversity in Diffusion Policy Optimization RLRobot

diffusion policy optimization reinforcement learning alignment-diversity tradeoff reward optimization

简要说明：本文通过理论分析时间步更新并提出增量 Feynman-Kac 训练方法在扩散策略优化中实现更好的对齐-多样性平衡。

TLDR: This paper improves diffusion policy optimization by theoretically analyzing timestep updates and proposing an incremental Feynman-Kac training method to achieve better alignment-diversity tradeoffs in reinforcement learning post-training of diffusion models.

Abstract: Reinforcement learning based post training of diffusion models, such as Denoising Diffusion Policy Optimization (DDPO), optimizes a reverse diffusion process under a reward function. However, current approaches to reward optimizations do so at the cost of diversity and quality. In this paper, we provide better tradeoffs through careful theoretical considerations and method design. We analyze the theoretical framework and mathematically demonstrate that \emph{only-latter timestep} updates of diffusion model may be harmful for diversity contrary to the conclusions presented in a previous work. Additionally, we propose an incremental Feynman-Kac training based on strong theoretical foundations in order to achieve the best-yet alignment-diversity tradeoffs. We perform extensive experiments and compare our method against related diffusion policy optimization approaches in three different tasks and also provide strong ablations for each component, thus validating strong performance gains in both alignment and diversity.

摘要（中文）：基于强化学习的扩散模型后训练方法，如去噪扩散策略优化（DDPO），在奖励函数下优化逆向扩散过程。然而，当前的奖励优化方法以牺牲多样性和质量为代价。本文通过细致的理论考量与方法设计，实现了更优的权衡。我们分析了理论框架，并从数学上证明，与先前工作中的结论相反，仅对扩散模型的后期时间步进行更新可能对多样性有害。此外，我们基于坚实的理论基础提出了一种增量式Feynman-Kac训练方法，以实现目前最佳的“对齐-多样性”权衡。我们进行了大量实验，在三个不同任务中将我们的方法与相关的扩散策略优化方法进行了比较，并对每个组成部分提供了充分的消融研究，从而验证了在对齐性和多样性方面的显著性能提升。

Authors: Ashok Prasad Neupane, Saugat Adhikari, Pramish Paudel, Ajad Chhatkuli, Danda Pani Paudel

Network World Models as Environments for Algorithm Design on Complex Systems WorldModel

action-conditioned world model network diffusion dynamics algorithm design counterfactual probes fast rollouts

简要说明：论文提出了网络世界模型，这是一种在干预下学习网络扩散动态的动作条件世界模型，作为算法设计循环中的快速评估器，在网络任务上优于基线。

TLDR: The paper introduces Network World Models, action-conditioned world models that learn network diffusion dynamics under interventions to serve as fast evaluators in an algorithm design loop, outperforming baselines on network tasks.

Abstract: World models, which simulate an environment and predict how it changes under actions, are increasingly used in real-world applications such as robotics. Complex systems call for the same tool because the effect of an action is not immediate. Seeding nodes for a campaign, or immunizing nodes against an epidemic, changes little on its own; what matters is the outcome that unfolds over the steps that follow. Designing an algorithm that selects such actions to maximize expected performance on a task is inherently iterative, and every candidate must be scored by the outcome it produces. Obtaining that outcome has relied on simulation, whose cost becomes a bottleneck when candidates are evaluated over many sampled trajectories. We propose an action-conditioned Network World Model that learns a network's diffusion dynamics under interventions over time, applies each action to the network, and predicts the outcome that follows. It serves as a fast evaluator inside an algorithm design loop in which a coding agent designs and refines executable algorithms using feedback from full rollouts, action-level credit, and counterfactual probes over alternative interventions. Across eight network tasks and five diffusion models, the designed algorithms match or exceed the strongest reported baseline in 138 of 141 settings while enabling up to 14.5 times faster rollouts than Monte Carlo simulation. Code will be released upon acceptance.

摘要（中文）：世界模型通过模拟环境并预测其在行动作用下的变化，正越来越多地被应用于机器人技术等实际场景中。复杂系统同样需要这一工具，因为行动的效果往往并非即时显现。例如，为一场活动选择种子节点，或针对疫情进行免疫接种，短期内可能改变甚微；真正重要的是后续步骤中逐步展开的结果。设计一种算法以选择此类行动，从而最大化任务预期表现，本质上是一个迭代过程，每个候选方案都必须根据其产生的结果进行评分。而获取这些结果历来依赖模拟，当候选方案在大量采样轨迹上进行评估时，模拟成本便成为瓶颈。我们提出了一种基于行动条件的网络世界模型，该模型学习网络在干预措施作用下随时间的扩散动力学，将每种行动应用于网络，并预测随之而来的结果。该模型可作为算法设计循环中的快速评估器，在此循环中，编码代理利用完整轨迹展开、行动级信用分配以及针对替代干预的反事实探测反馈，来设计和改进可执行算法。在八个网络任务和五种扩散模型中，所设计算法在141种设置中的138种中达到或超过了最强已报道基线，同时实现了比蒙特卡洛模拟快高达14.5倍的轨迹展开速度。代码将在论文被接收后发布。

Latent-Foresight: End-to-End Learning Predictable Representations for Latent World Models WorldModel

world models latent tokenizer flow-based generative dynamics temporal predictability future scene understanding

简要说明：Latent-Foresight 提出了一种端到端框架，联合学习潜在分词器和基于流的生成动力学模型，以塑造可预测的表示用于未来场景理解，在无需分离训练阶段的情况下优于两阶段基线。

TLDR: Latent-Foresight proposes an end-to-end framework that jointly learns a latent tokenizer and a flow-based generative dynamics model to shape predictable representations for future scene understanding, outperforming two-stage baselines without separate training stages.

Abstract: Predicting the future evolution of a scene is a fundamental capability for world modeling. Recent work has shown that operating in the feature space of Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) yields semantically rich representations that support diverse future scene understanding tasks. However, existing approaches rely on two-stage pipelines, where VFM features are first compressed using fixed dimensionality reduction (e.g., PCA) or independently trained autoencoders, and a separate predictor is trained on top of the resulting frozen latent space. This decoupling between representation learning and temporal prediction, as well as approaches that apply predictors directly on raw VFM features, provides no guarantee that the latent space is structured for predictable dynamics. In this work, we propose Latent-Foresight, an end-to-end framework that jointly learns a latent tokenizer and a flow-based generative dynamics model, explicitly shaping the representation to support temporal predictability. To enable stable joint optimization, we introduce several key design choices that prevent latent collapse and align reconstruction with generative objectives. Extensive experiments show that our approach learns more temporally coherent latent representations and consistently outperforms two-stage baselines across multiple future scene understanding tasks and prediction horizons, while eliminating separate training stages, including during high-resolution adaptation. We provide the implementation code and model weights at https://github.com/Sta8is/Latent-Foresight

摘要（中文）：预测场景未来演变是世界建模的一项基本能力。近期研究表明，在视觉基础模型（VFM）的特征空间中操作，能够获得语义丰富的表征，从而支持多种未来场景理解任务。然而，现有方法依赖于两阶段流程，即首先使用固定降维技术（如主成分分析）或独立训练的自编码器对VFM特征进行压缩，然后在所得的冻结潜空间之上训练独立的预测器。这种表征学习与时间预测之间的解耦，以及直接在原始VFM特征上应用预测器的方法，都无法保证潜空间具备适于可预测动态的结构化特性。在本工作中，我们提出Latent-Foresight，一种端到端框架，联合学习潜分词器与基于流的生成式动力学模型，显式地将表征塑造成支持时间可预测性的形式。为实现稳定的联合优化，我们引入了若干关键设计选择，以防止潜空间坍缩，并使重建目标与生成目标保持一致。大量实验表明，我们的方法学习到的潜表征具有更强的时间连贯性，并在多项未来场景理解任务及预测时域上始终优于两阶段基线方法，同时消除了包括高分辨率适配在内的独立训练阶段。我们在https://github.com/Sta8is/Latent-Foresight 提供实现代码和模型权重。
